examples.en: The fictional media Q&A document explains when the temporary study room opens and how to find it.
examples.zh: 虚构「媒体问答资料」解释了临时自习室何时开放以及如何找到它。

examples.en: Our class uses the media Q&A document to compare answers prepared for two different fictional opening schedules.
examples.zh: 全班用「媒体问答资料」比较为两个不同虚构开放日程准备的答案。

collocations: questions covered by a media Q&A document

words.enDefinition: A session set aside for journalists to ask questions and receive answers from an organisation's representatives.

examples.en: A media Q&A session follows the briefing so reporters can ask about the changed opening hours.
examples.zh: 说明会之后设有「媒体问答环节」，记者可以询问调整后的开放时间。

examples.en: The sample transcript shows how the media Q&A session addressed questions about transport to the venue.
examples.zh: 文字记录样本展示了「媒体问答环节」怎样回应前往会场的交通问题。

collocations: questions during a media Q&A session

words.enDefinition: a media seller's published schedule of rates for different advertising spaces or times

examples.en: The media rate card showed different prices for a full page and a half page.
examples.zh: 「媒体广告价目表」列出了整版和半版的不同价格。

examples.en: The buyer checked the media rate card before asking whether discounts were available to local charities.
examples.zh: 采购人员查阅「媒体广告价目表」后，询问本地慈善机构能否享受折扣。

words.enDefinition: The part of public relations concerned with ongoing communication between an organisation and news media.

examples.en: The seminar introduces media relations through a fictional museum answering local reporters' questions about an exhibition.
examples.zh: 研讨课用虚构博物馆回答当地记者关于展览的问题，介绍「媒体关系」。

examples.en: Our casebook treats media relations as ongoing work, including responding to enquiries after the event has ended.
examples.zh: 案例教材把「媒体关系」视为持续性工作，包括在活动结束后回应咨询。

words.enDefinition: An agreed procedure for receiving, verifying, approving, and responding to questions from news media.

examples.en: The fictional media response protocol identifies which office confirms dates before a spokesperson answers press questions publicly.
examples.zh: 虚构「媒体回应规程」规定，发言人公开回答新闻提问之前，由哪个部门确认日期。

examples.en: Our class checks whether the media response protocol identifies a person responsible for correcting a published mistake.
examples.zh: 全班核对「媒体回应规程」是否指明由谁负责纠正已经公布的错误。

collocations: responsibilities under a media response protocol

words.enDefinition: the timetable showing when advertisements will appear in selected channels

examples.en: The media schedule listed the publication dates for each newspaper advertisement during the campaign.
examples.zh: 「媒体投放排期」列出了活动期间每则报纸广告的刊登日期。

examples.en: The designer checked the media schedule before promising when the final files would be ready.
examples.zh: 设计师查过「媒体投放排期」才答复最终文件何时交付。

words.enDefinition: An official comment or position an organisation provides to journalists on a particular issue or event.

examples.en: The fictional college issues a media statement confirming that its reading room will reopen on Monday.
examples.zh: 虚构大学发出一份「向媒体发布的声明」，确认阅览室将于周一重新开放。

examples.en: Our casebook compares the media statement with the more detailed background material supplied to the fictional reporters.
examples.zh: 案例教材将「向媒体发布的声明」与发给虚构记者的较详细背景材料作比较。

words.enDefinition: a particular publication, station, site, or programme used to carry an advertisement

examples.en: The newsletter was the cheapest media vehicle that reached readers interested in the new workshop.
examples.zh: 这份通讯是在对新工作坊感兴趣的读者中投放成本最低的「具体媒介载体」。

examples.en: The planner listed a different media vehicle in each town for the same radio campaign.
examples.zh: 规划人员为同一项广播宣传活动在每个城镇列出了不同的「具体媒介载体」。

words.enDefinition: advertising exposure delivered outside the audience that a media plan intends to reach

examples.en: The media planner estimated media waste by counting exposures outside the audience specified in the brief.
examples.zh: 媒体规划人员统计简报指定受众之外的曝光，估算「媒体投放浪费」。

examples.en: Our class compared media waste across two magazines with different proportions of the intended readership.
examples.zh: 课堂对比了目标读者占比不同的两本杂志的「媒体投放浪费」。

words.enDefinition: Intermediary bringing wholesale buyers and sellers together for particular transactions

examples.en: The hypothetical merchandise broker brings an independent store and a supplier together.
examples.zh: 假想的「商品交易经纪人」为独立商店和供应商牵线。

examples.en: We discussed the fee paid to the merchandise broker for arranging the sale.
examples.zh: 我们讨论了为促成交易而支付给「商品交易经纪人」的费用。

collocations: deal arranged by a merchandise broker

words.enDefinition: Independent wholesaler taking ownership of goods for resale to businesses

examples.en: The case shows a merchant wholesaler buying notebooks before reselling them to shops.
examples.zh: 案例展示了一家「经销型批发商」先买下笔记本，再转售给商店。

examples.en: We checked whether the merchant wholesaler owned the goods shown in our diagram.
examples.zh: 我们查看示意图中的商品是否由「经销型批发商」拥有。

words.enDefinition: the basis on which an advertisement seeks to persuade, such as reason, emotion, or social values

examples.en: The class discussed whether the message appeal depended more on practical savings or shared values.
examples.zh: 课堂讨论这则「广告诉求」更依赖实际节省还是共同价值观。

examples.en: The research team asked respondents which message appeal stayed with them after watching the spots.
examples.zh: 研究团队询问受访者，看完短广告后对哪种「广告诉求」还有印象。

words.enDefinition: the extent to which viewers correctly understand an advertisement's claims, conditions, or instructions

examples.en: The quiz measured message comprehension by asking which services the basic payment actually covered.
examples.zh: 小测验询问基础费用究竟涵盖何种服务，以衡量「广告信息理解度」。

examples.en: Message comprehension improved after the team replaced an unfamiliar abbreviation with a short explanation.
examples.zh: 团队将陌生缩写改成一句简短解释后，「广告信息理解度」有所提升。

words.enDefinition: Agreement of central facts and points across communications while allowing wording or presentation to vary.

examples.en: The fictional team checks message consistency by comparing the dates given in a briefing and a public notice.
examples.zh: 虚构团队对照说明会和公众通知给出的日期，检查「传播口径一致性」。

examples.en: Our class finds message consistency in two announcements that use different wording but give the same opening hours.
examples.zh: 全班在两份措辞不同、却给出相同开放时间的公告中看到了「传播口径一致性」。

words.enDefinition: A visual framework shaped like a house, with an overarching message supported by pillars and evidence.

examples.en: The course handout illustrates a message house using the fictional museum's central idea and three supporting points.
examples.zh: 课程讲义借虚构博物馆的一项中心观点和三项支撑要点，说明「房屋式信息框架」。

examples.en: Our group identified which facts supported the pillars in the message house printed in the sample communication plan.
examples.zh: 小组辨认哪些事实支撑样本传播计划中「房屋式信息框架」的各根支柱。

words.zhGloss: 媒体报道对核心信息的体现
words.enDefinition: The extent to which designated key messages are reflected in independent coverage or other analysed content.
acceptedZhAnswers: 媒体报道对核心信息的体现

examples.en: The fictional evaluation examines message pull-through by checking whether local coverage included the central point about public access.
examples.zh: 虚构评估核对当地报道是否包含公众使用权限这一核心要点，以分析「媒体报道对核心信息的体现」。

examples.en: Our class distinguishes message pull-through from simply counting how many articles mention the fictional institution by name.
examples.zh: 全班把「媒体报道对核心信息的体现」与仅统计多少篇文章提到虚构机构名称的做法区分开。

words.enDefinition: a plan for what an advertisement will communicate and the audience response it seeks

examples.en: The message strategy emphasized convenience because the new exhibition offered shorter visits for families.
examples.zh: 新展允许家庭缩短参观时间，因此「信息传播策略」强调便利性。

examples.en: The brief sets out a message strategy that focuses on the value of the repair service.
examples.zh: 简报制定了一套突出维修服务价值的「信息传播策略」。

words.enDefinition: the main point an audience comes away with after seeing or hearing an advertisement

examples.en: The message takeout was about faster delivery, although the poster was intended to emphasize repairs.
examples.zh: 受众「接收到的主旨」是配送更快，虽然海报本意是宣传维修。

examples.en: The researcher asked people to explain the message takeout in their own words after viewing.
examples.zh: 研究人员让观众看完后，用自己的话说出「接收到的主旨」。

words.enDefinition: A structure organising the key ideas, supporting points, and audience considerations of communication on a topic.

examples.en: The sample messaging framework groups the fictional library's main points with the details supporting each one.
examples.zh: 「传播信息框架」样本把虚构图书馆的主要要点及其各自的支撑细节归在一起。

examples.en: Our exercise uses the messaging framework to identify why the internal briefing and public notice cover similar facts.
examples.zh: 练习用「传播信息框架」说明为什么内部说明会和公众通知都涵盖相似的事实。

words.enDefinition: A separate section in a report outlining the sources and methods behind its findings.

examples.en: The methodology box explained where the public figures came from and how the reporter counted repeat visits.
examples.zh: 「方法说明栏」解释了公开数据来自哪里，以及记者如何统计重复到访。

examples.en: We added a methodology box beside the chart so readers could understand the two-year comparison.
examples.zh: 我们在图表旁添加「方法说明栏」，让读者看懂这项跨两年的比较。

collocations: include a methodology box with a story

words.enDefinition: Compact facility located near customers for preparing online retail orders

examples.en: The plan places a microfulfillment center closer to customers than the main warehouse.
examples.zh: 方案把「微型履约中心」设在比主仓库更靠近顾客的地点。

examples.en: We compared the microfulfillment center with a central facility serving the entire region.
examples.zh: 我们将「微型履约中心」与服务整个地区的中央设施作了比较。

words.enDefinition: a video or audio advertisement played during a break within the main content

examples.en: The editor placed a mid-roll ad at the break between two sections of the interview.
examples.zh: 剪辑师在访谈两个段落之间的休息处放了一则「中插广告」。

examples.en: The class considered whether a mid-roll ad would interrupt a key moment in the demonstration.
examples.zh: 课堂讨论「中插广告」是否会打断演示的关键时刻。

words.enDefinition: Minimum amount a distributor promises in exchange for specified distribution rights

examples.en: The sample deal lists a minimum guarantee separately from possible later revenue shares.
examples.zh: 样例交易将「最低保底发行款」与之后可能分到的收入分开列出。

examples.en: We discussed how the minimum guarantee appeared in the fictional film's financing plan.
examples.zh: 我们讨论了虚构影片的融资方案如何列示「最低保底发行款」。

words.enDefinition: An image crop that gives an inaccurate impression by removing relevant visual context.

examples.en: The editor spotted a misleading crop when the uncropped exhibition image showed important details outside the frame.
examples.zh: 未裁切的展览照片显示，画面外还有重要细节，编辑发现这是「误导性图片裁切」。

examples.en: We explained the misleading crop by showing what the full public photograph actually included.
examples.zh: 我们展示公开原照片包含哪些内容，以说明「误导性图片裁切」造成的误解。

collocations: compare a misleading crop with the original

words.enDefinition: A concept test in which each participant evaluates one concept, with any comparisons made across separate groups.

examples.en: The class reads a fictional monadic concept test report where each group assessed only one product idea.
examples.zh: 全班阅读一份虚构「单概念独立测评」报告，其中各小组只评价一项产品构想。

examples.en: Our tutor asks why a monadic concept test does not contain within-person comparisons of the two fictional concepts.
examples.zh: 老师询问，为什么「单概念独立测评」不包含同一个人对两项虚构概念作出的对比。

collocations: results of a monadic concept test
compare a monadic concept test with another format

words.enDefinition: a method that can distribute conversion credit among multiple interactions preceding the desired action

examples.en: The team used multi-touch attribution to share credit across the newsletter and later advertisement clicks.
examples.zh: 团队采用「多触点归因」，把贡献分配给通讯和其后的广告点击。

examples.en: Our class compared two rules for distributing credit within the same multi-touch attribution exercise.
examples.zh: 课堂在同一项「多触点归因」练习中对比了两种分配贡献的规则。

words.enDefinition: Disagreement or friction arising when different selling channels overlap in serving customers

examples.en: The case describes multichannel conflict when direct online sales overlap with dealers' sales.
examples.zh: 案例描述了线上直销与经销商销售重合时的「多渠道冲突」。

examples.en: We read the distributor's comments before discussing multichannel conflict in the worksheet.
examples.zh: 我们先阅读分销商的意见，再讨论习题中的「多渠道冲突」。

words.enDefinition: Selling through multiple channels that may operate as separate parts of the business

examples.en: The example uses multichannel retailing through its website, printed catalog, and neighborhood shops.
examples.zh: 案例企业通过网站、印刷目录和社区商店开展「多渠道零售」。

examples.en: We discussed multichannel retailing even though each channel in the case kept separate records.
examples.zh: 尽管案例中各渠道分别保存记录，我们仍讨论了其「多渠道零售」模式。

words.enDefinition: Audio track containing music and effects for use with replacement dialogue

examples.en: The localization team needs the music and effects track to preserve the background sound during dubbing.
examples.zh: 本地化团队需要「音乐音效轨」，以便配音时保留原有背景声音。

examples.en: We listed the music and effects track separately from the original language dialogue in the delivery plan.
examples.zh: 我们在交付方案中将「音乐音效轨」与原声对白分别列出。

collocations: deliver a music and effects track
check the music and effects track
prepare a music and effects track

words.enDefinition: Obtaining permission to use specified music in a screen production

examples.en: The group lists music clearance as a separate task for its fictional short.
examples.zh: 小组把「音乐使用授权」列为虚构短片的一项单独工作。

examples.en: We distinguished music clearance from recording where a song appeared in the edit.
examples.zh: 我们把取得「音乐使用授权」和记录歌曲出现在剪辑的哪个位置区分开来。

words.enDefinition: Record identifying music used in a production and details of each use

examples.en: The music cue sheet lists the track, its placement, and how long it plays.
examples.zh: 「音乐使用明细表」列出了曲目、出现位置和播放时长。

examples.en: We checked the music cue sheet after shortening the music under the final scene.
examples.zh: 缩短最后一场戏的配乐后，我们查看了「音乐使用明细表」。

words.enDefinition: Identifying a source by name when reporting their information or words.

examples.en: The editor used named attribution for the timetable explanation after the librarian agreed to be quoted.
examples.zh: 图书管理员同意被引用后，编辑对这段时间表说明采用了「具名归因」。

examples.en: We checked that named attribution in the draft gave the speaker's approved name and relevant position.
examples.zh: 我们核对草稿中的「具名归因」是否使用了说话者确认的姓名，并注明与报道相关的职务。

collocations: write a sentence with named attribution
seek named attribution for a claim

words.enDefinition: A source identified by name in a published account.

examples.en: The story used a named source who could confirm when the new library schedule would begin.
examples.zh: 这篇报道采用了「实名消息来源」的消息，对方能够确认图书馆何时启用新的开放安排。

examples.en: The editor asked whether the named source had personally attended the meeting mentioned in the draft.
examples.zh: 编辑问，「实名消息来源」是否亲自参加过草稿中提到的会议。

words.enDefinition: paid advertising designed to fit the normal form and experience of the medium in which it appears

examples.en: The team studied native advertising by comparing a clearly marked paid article with regular magazine features.
examples.zh: 团队通过比较明确标注的付费文章和常规杂志专题，研究「原生广告」。

examples.en: The tutor asked students to identify the label that distinguished native advertising from editorial material.
examples.zh: 导师要求学生找出用于区分「原生广告」和编辑内容的标识。

words.enDefinition: In the consumer decision process, noticing a difference between one's current situation and a desired one.

examples.en: The fictional story illustrates need recognition when the student notices their old folder no longer closes properly.
examples.zh: 虚构故事以一名学生发现旧文件夹盖不紧的时点，说明「需求识别」。

examples.en: Our class discusses need recognition before the character begins comparing containers for the new university studio.
examples.zh: 我们在角色开始为大学新工作室比较容器以前，讨论「需求识别」这一阶段。

words.enDefinition: Grouping consumers according to the problems they want solved or the needs they want met.

examples.en: The classroom case uses needs-based segmentation to separate people seeking easier storage from those seeking convenient transport.
examples.zh: 课堂案例用「基于需求的细分」区分想更容易收纳的人和想更方便携带的人。

examples.en: Our worksheet compares needs-based segmentation with a fictional grouping that ignores why consumers want the product.
examples.zh: 练习单把「基于需求的细分」与一个忽略消费者为何想要产品的虚构分组作比较。

words.enDefinition: In satisfaction research, a comparison in which experienced performance falls short of the consumer's prior expectations.

examples.en: The case illustrates negative disconfirmation when the fictional shopper reports that the box held fewer items than expected.
examples.zh: 案例中，虚构购物者报告盒子容纳的物品少于预想，体现了「实际表现低于预期」。

examples.en: The class distinguishes negative disconfirmation from simply having low expectations before using the product in the example.
examples.zh: 全班区分了「实际表现低于预期」和使用虚构产品前原本就抱有较低期望。

words.enDefinition: Developing a market offering from its initial idea through preparation for launch.

examples.en: The new product development plan moved from an initial sketch to a trial offering for students.
examples.zh: 「新产品开发」计划从初稿推进到供学生试用的版本。

examples.en: Students mapped new product development to see which decisions came before the fictional item was ready to sell.
examples.zh: 学生绘制「新产品开发」流程图，查看模拟商品上架前需要先作出哪些决定。

collocations: a phase of new product development

words.zhGloss: 本公司首次推出的产品
words.enDefinition: An offering new to a particular business but already established in the wider market.
acceptedZhAnswers: 本公司首次推出的产品

examples.en: The fictional brand's first desk lamp was a new-to-the-company product in a market with several competitors.
examples.zh: 市场上已有多个竞争者，虚构品牌的首款台灯是「本公司首次推出的产品」。

examples.en: We classified it as a new-to-the-company product because buyers could already find similar products elsewhere.
examples.zh: 我们将它归类为「本公司首次推出的产品」，因为买家早就能从别处找到类似产品。

words.enDefinition: An offering new to any market rather than merely new to its seller.

examples.en: The class asked what evidence would support calling the fictional notebook design a new-to-the-world product.
examples.zh: 全班询问，什么证据能支持把这款虚构笔记本设计称为「全球首创新产品」。

examples.en: The case compared a new-to-the-world product with an existing design offered by another company for years.
examples.zh: 案例将「全球首创新产品」与另一家公司已销售多年的现有设计作比较。

words.enDefinition: Reporting that interprets developments using evidence and context beyond the basic facts.

examples.en: The news analysis compared earlier transport decisions to explain why the new route mattered to commuters.
examples.zh: 这篇「新闻分析」比较以往交通决定，解释新线路为什么对通勤者重要。

examples.en: We labeled the article news analysis because it interpreted the evidence instead of merely summarizing the announcement.
examples.zh: 文章解读了证据，超出了概述公告的范围，所以我们将它标为「新闻分析」。

words.enDefinition: The specific aspect or perspective that guides how a news story is reported.

examples.en: The team chose a news angle focused on how the plan would affect students who commute.
examples.zh: 小组选择的「新闻报道角度」是这项计划如何影响通勤学生。

examples.en: We changed the news angle after interviews showed that evening access mattered more than the new building.
examples.zh: 采访发现晚间能否使用设施比新建筑更重要，于是我们调整了「新闻报道角度」。

words.enDefinition: A short report stating the essential facts about one development.

examples.en: The news brief gave the new opening time and told students which entrance would remain available.
examples.zh: 「简讯」提供了新的开放时间，还告诉学生哪个入口依然开放。

examples.en: We wrote a news brief first because readers needed the basic transport information before the longer article.
examples.zh: 我们先写「简讯」，因为读者在看到长篇报道之前就需要基本交通信息。

collocations: include an item in a news brief

words.enDefinition: A branch office maintaining reporting coverage of a particular location or region.

examples.en: The fictional newspaper assigned two reporters to its news bureau near the second campus.
examples.zh: 虚构报社派两名记者到第二校区附近的「新闻驻地机构」工作。

examples.en: Our class examined how the news bureau kept the central desk informed about events in its area.
examples.zh: 全班考察了「新闻驻地机构」如何向总部编辑台通报当地的各项动态。

words.enDefinition: A journalist assigned by a news organization to report from a particular location or region.

examples.en: The outlet's news correspondent filed a report from the town where the student debate took place.
examples.zh: 这家媒体的「驻地记者」从学生辩论比赛举行的小城发回了报道。

examples.en: Our class compared the news correspondent's account with a summary prepared by editors back at headquarters.
examples.zh: 全班把「驻地记者」的报道与总部编辑编写的摘要作比较。

collocations: a report from a news correspondent

words.enDefinition: The editorial team coordinating incoming reports and current news coverage.

examples.en: The reporter sent the confirmed timetable to the news desk once the library posted it publicly.
examples.zh: 图书馆公开时间表后，记者把已核实的时间表发给了「新闻编辑台」。

examples.en: The news desk decided which of the two student articles should lead the evening bulletin.
examples.zh: 「新闻编辑台」决定晚上新闻简报的头条应当选两篇学生报道中的哪一篇。

collocations: send updates to the news desk

words.enDefinition: An editor who selects, oversees, and prepares current news coverage at an outlet.

examples.en: The news editor asked for a second account before approving the student story about the library opening.
examples.zh: 「新闻编辑」要求找另一份说法，再批准关于图书馆开馆的学生报道。

examples.en: Our news editor placed the transport update ahead of the club profile in the afternoon edition.
examples.zh: 在下午版中，我们的「新闻编辑」把交通更新排在社团人物报道之前。

collocations: a decision by the news editor

words.enDefinition: A reported article developing a subject through detail, context, or narrative.

examples.en: The news feature used interviews with several student gardeners to explain how the shared plot had developed.
examples.zh: 这篇「新闻特写」采访了几名参与园艺的学生，说明共享种植区的发展过程。

examples.en: We expanded the news feature after finding earlier records that explained why the project began.
examples.zh: 找到能解释项目缘起的早期记录后，我们扩充了「新闻特写」。

words.enDefinition: The space available for editorial content in a print publication after other allocations.

examples.en: The printed issue had a smaller news hole after the bookstore advertisement took half a page.
examples.zh: 书店广告占了半页，这期纸质刊物的「新闻可用版面」变小了。

examples.en: Our class shortened two articles to fit the news hole in the simulated campus edition.
examples.zh: 全班缩短了两篇文章，以适应模拟校园刊物的「新闻可用版面」。

collocations: fit a story into the news hole

words.enDefinition: The ability to decide what deserves coverage and how prominently it should appear.

examples.en: The editor used news judgment to place the library closure above the story about new shelves.
examples.zh: 编辑运用「新闻判断力」，把图书馆关闭的新闻排在介绍新书架的稿件前面。

examples.en: Our class discussed news judgment after two groups independently selected different stories for the front page.
examples.zh: 两个小组各自选出了不同的头版报道后，全班讨论了「新闻判断力」。

words.enDefinition: A current event or development that makes a topic timely to report now.

examples.en: The publication of a new bus timetable gave our article about campus transport a clear news peg.
examples.zh: 新公交时间表的发布，为我们的校园交通报道提供了明确的「新闻由头」。

examples.en: The editor asked for a news peg because the same library issue had existed for years.
examples.zh: 图书馆的同一个问题已存在多年，编辑要求找一个当下的「新闻由头」。

collocations: use a development as a news peg

words.enDefinition: A single report summarizing several related news developments.

examples.en: The weekly news roundup summarized several campus announcements that students might have missed during exam week.
examples.zh: 每周「新闻综览」汇总了几条学生可能在考试周漏看的校园公告。

examples.en: We arranged the news roundup by subject so readers could find transport updates without scanning every item.
examples.zh: 我们按主题编排「新闻综览」，读者无须逐条查看就能找到交通更新。

words.enDefinition: Distributing the same article or regular feature for publication by multiple outlets.

examples.en: The case used news syndication to show how the same student column ran in three local papers.
examples.zh: 案例用「新闻稿件联供」说明同一篇学生专栏是怎么在三家当地报纸上刊登的。

examples.en: We discussed news syndication after the fictional publisher considered offering its weekly column to other outlets.
examples.zh: 虚构发行方考虑向其他媒体供应自己的每周专栏后，我们讨论了「新闻稿件联供」。

words.enDefinition: A team or workplace that gathers, edits, and publishes news.

examples.en: The student newsroom moved its planning meeting earlier so reporters could cover the afternoon library opening.
examples.zh: 学生「新闻采编部」把策划会提前，让记者能报道下午的图书馆开馆活动。

examples.en: Our class visited a newsroom and watched editors discuss which stories needed further checks before publication.
examples.zh: 全班参观了一家「新闻采编部」，看到编辑讨论哪些报道在发表前还需要核查。

words.enDefinition: The degree to which an event or issue deserves coverage according to journalistic criteria.

examples.en: The tutor explained newsworthiness by asking how many readers would be affected by the timetable change.
examples.zh: 辅导老师通过询问会有多少读者受到时间表调整影响来解释「新闻报道价值」。

examples.en: We debated the newsworthiness of two campus topics before selecting one for the class assignment.
examples.zh: 全班在选择作业选题前，讨论了两个校园议题的「新闻报道价值」。

collocations: discuss the newsworthiness of a story

words.enDefinition: The next update listed for a stated time or place in a communication schedule.

examples.en: The fictional venue notice gives the time of the next scheduled update about its temporary opening hours.
examples.zh: 虚构场馆通知给出关于临时开放时段的「下一次计划通报」时间。

examples.en: Our class checks whether the next scheduled update actually appeared as promised in the fictional timeline here.
examples.zh: 全班核查，在这条虚构时间线上，「下一次计划通报」是否确实如约发布。

collocations: time of the next scheduled update
wait for the next scheduled update

words.expression: no response to a request for comment
words.lemma: no response to a request for comment
words.enDefinition: No answer received from a person or organization after a reporter requested their response.
acceptedEnVariants: no response to a request for comment
did not respond to a request for comment

examples.en: The article noted no response to a request for comment by the time it went to press.
examples.zh: 报道注明，截至截稿时仍然「征询置评未获回应」。

examples.en: We wrote that the university did not respond to a request for comment by the deadline.
examples.zh: 我们在稿件中注明，截至截稿时，向该大学「征询置评未获回应」。

collocations: note no response to a request for comment
report no response to a request for comment
record no response to a request for comment

words.enDefinition: Circulation of films for screenings outside conventional commercial cinema exhibition

examples.en: The case uses non-theatrical distribution to reach clubs and educational venues across the region.
examples.zh: 案例通过「非院线发行」触达全地区的社团与教育场地。

examples.en: We discussed whether the museum screenings belonged to the non-theatrical distribution plan.
examples.zh: 我们讨论了博物馆放映是否属于「非院线发行」方案。

words.enDefinition: An evaluation rule under which weakness on one key attribute cannot always be offset by strengths on other attributes.

examples.en: The worksheet illustrates a noncompensatory decision rule when the fictional buyer rejects every item too large for storage.
examples.zh: 练习单用虚构买家拒绝所有放不进储物空间的物品这一例子，说明「非补偿性决策规则」。

examples.en: Our class discussed how a noncompensatory decision rule differs from adding all the fictional product scores together.
examples.zh: 全班讨论「非补偿性决策规则」与把虚构产品的所有评分相加有何区别。

words.enDefinition: A physical product normally consumed or used up relatively quickly.

examples.en: The classroom catalogue designated printer paper as a nondurable good because the sheets were used up regularly.
examples.zh: 课堂产品目录把打印纸列作「非耐用品」，因为这些纸会经常用完。

examples.en: The fictional shop expected its usual buyers to replace this nondurable good much sooner than a reusable case.
examples.zh: 虚构商店预计熟客补购这件「非耐用品」的频率会比更换可重复使用的外盒高得多。

words.zhGloss: 不偏袒政党的公众沟通
words.enDefinition: Public information provided without promoting a political party or taking a party-political position.
acceptedZhAnswers: 不偏袒政党的公众沟通

examples.en: The public service course presents nonpartisan public communication through a fictional notice explaining changes to library services.
examples.zh: 公共服务课程借一份解释图书馆服务变动的虚构通知，介绍「不偏袒政党的公众沟通」。

examples.en: Our class checks that nonpartisan public communication in the example addresses all users of the public service.
examples.zh: 全班核对示例中「不偏袒政党的公众沟通」是否面向公共服务的所有使用者。

words.enDefinition: Selling to consumers through channels outside physical retail stores

examples.en: The lecture illustrates nonstore retailing using online catalogs and a vending example.
examples.zh: 讲座用线上目录和自动售货的例子说明「无店铺零售」。

examples.en: Our group discussed nonstore retailing before mapping the fictional brand's direct sales channels.
examples.zh: 我们组先讨论「无店铺零售」，再绘制虚构品牌的直接销售渠道。

words.enDefinition: A section appended to some press releases containing background details or practical information for journalists.

examples.en: The fictional press release places notes to editors after the main text and includes background on the organisation.
examples.zh: 虚构公关新闻稿把「致编辑附注」放在正文之后，并附上机构背景。

examples.en: Our class identifies which paragraph belongs under notes to editors for the fictional community exhibition announcement.
examples.zh: 全班辨认，虚构社区展览公告中的哪一段属于「致编辑附注」。

collocations: details in the notes to editors

words.enDefinition: An early paragraph explaining what the story is about and why it matters.

examples.en: The nut graf connected one student's experience with the wider changes in evening access across campus.
examples.zh: 「点题段」把一名学生的经历与校园晚间开放安排的整体变化联系起来。

examples.en: We moved the nut graf higher so readers would understand the significance before reaching the interview details.
examples.zh: 我们把「点题段」移到更前面，让读者在看到采访细节前就能明白报道的意义。

words.enDefinition: a budgeting method that estimates the cost of specific activities needed to meet stated objectives

examples.en: The objective-and-task method priced the work required to inform residents before the new bus route opened.
examples.zh: 「目标任务预算法」估算了在新公交线路开通前告知居民所需的工作费用。

examples.en: The group used the objective-and-task method after estimating the cost of each planned school outreach activity.
examples.zh: 小组估算学校每项联络活动的成本后，采用了「目标任务预算法」。

words.enDefinition: Grouping consumers by the situations or events associated with buying or using a product.

examples.en: The textbook uses occasion segmentation to distinguish purchases for routine studio work from purchases for a fictional exhibition.
examples.zh: 教材用「按场合细分」区分日常工作室使用的采购和为虚构展览所作的采购。

examples.en: Our class asks which fictional groups arise from occasion segmentation in the sample report on storage supplies.
examples.zh: 全班询问，收纳用品样本报告里的哪些虚构群体来自「按场合细分」。

words.enDefinition: Using odd or rounded price endings to convey different price impressions

examples.en: The example uses odd-even pricing to contrast a near-round price with a round one.
examples.zh: 示例用「奇偶定价」对比了接近整数的价格与整数价格。

examples.en: Our group discussed odd-even pricing after comparing two price tags for the same item.
examples.zh: 我们组对照了同一商品的两张价格标签后，讨论了「奇偶定价」。

words.enDefinition: Retailer selling branded merchandise below typical prices using opportunistic sourcing

examples.en: The fictional off-price retailer sells surplus branded items acquired from several producers.
examples.zh: 虚构的「低价品牌折扣零售商」出售从多家生产商购入的品牌余货。

examples.en: We compared the changing stock of an off-price retailer with a standard assortment.
examples.zh: 我们将一家「低价品牌折扣零售商」不断变化的库存与常规商品组合作了比较。

words.enDefinition: Creative editing stage focused on selecting and assembling picture and sound

examples.en: The offline edit focuses on the timing of the scenes and the performances.
examples.zh: 「离线剪辑」着重处理场景的节奏与演员的表演。

examples.en: We used smaller files for the offline edit before preparing the images for delivery.
examples.zh: 在为画面交付做准备前，我们用较小的文件完成「离线剪辑」。

words.enDefinition: A survey combining separate sets of questions commissioned by different clients in one shared study.

examples.en: The fictional omnibus survey contains separate sections on storage products and food containers for two different clients.
examples.zh: 虚构「多客户合用问卷调查」包含两个分别给不同客户的板块，涉及储物产品和食品容器。

examples.en: Our tutor describes an omnibus survey as a shared vehicle for unrelated questions in the sample proposal.
examples.zh: 老师将「多客户合用问卷调查」描述为样本提案中承载互不相关问题的共同渠道。

collocations: include questions in an omnibus survey

words.enDefinition: Coordinating order delivery or pickup across multiple sales and inventory channels

examples.en: The case uses omnichannel fulfillment to handle web orders from stores or warehouses.
examples.zh: 案例采用「全渠道履约」，由门店或仓库处理网站订单。

examples.en: We discussed whether the two pickup methods used the same omnichannel fulfillment process.
examples.zh: 我们讨论了两种取货方式是否使用相同的「全渠道履约」流程。

words.enDefinition: Coordinated selling across channels so customers can move between them smoothly

examples.en: The case illustrates omnichannel retailing by connecting product discovery, checkout, and pickup across channels.
examples.zh: 案例将跨渠道的商品查找、结账和取货连接起来，说明「全渠道零售」。

examples.en: We compared omnichannel retailing with an approach that kept online and store systems separate.
examples.zh: 我们把「全渠道零售」与线上和实体店系统分开运行的做法作了比较。

words.enDefinition: Available for publication under agreed attribution conditions that ordinarily withhold the source's name.

examples.en: The classroom example described comments given on background with an agreed description of the source's role.
examples.zh: 课堂示例中，有些发言「可报道但按约定归因」，文中使用双方商定的方式描述来源的角色。

examples.en: We distinguished a statement offered on background from one the fictional report could attribute by name.
examples.zh: 我们将「可报道但按约定归因」的说法与可在虚构稿件中具名归因的发言作比较。

words.enDefinition: A statement delivered by a person in front of a camera for a media recording or broadcast.

examples.en: The fictional director gives an on-camera statement before the media ask questions about the new reading room.
examples.zh: 虚构总监在媒体就新阅览室提问之前发表了一份「面对镜头发表的声明」。

examples.en: Our class compares the on-camera statement with the written notice released by the fictional university that morning.
examples.zh: 全班将「面对镜头发表的声明」与虚构大学当日上午发布的书面通知作比较。

words.enDefinition: Share of expected product listings available to shoppers on store shelves

examples.en: The worksheet measures on-shelf availability using repeated checks of products on the sales floor.
examples.zh: 习题通过反复检查销售区里的商品来测量「货架有货率」。

examples.en: We compared on-shelf availability with measures of whether stock was present anywhere in store.
examples.zh: 我们将「货架有货率」与衡量商品在门店任何位置是否有货的指标作了比较。

words.enDefinition: Available for publication with the source identified, under the agreed interview terms.

examples.en: The organizer spoke on the record, so the article could name her when quoting the opening date.
examples.zh: 组织人员的发言「可具名公开引用」，因此文章引用开幕日期时可以写出她的姓名。

examples.en: The student reporter checked which comments were on the record before drafting the campus news brief.
examples.zh: 学生记者在起草校园简讯前，核实了哪些评论「可具名公开引用」。

collocations: confirm a statement on the record

words.enDefinition: Delivery performance measured by whether orders arrive complete by the promised time

examples.en: The workbook counts an order toward on-time in-full delivery only if it meets both conditions.
examples.zh: 练习册规定，只有同时满足两个条件的订单才计为「准时足量交付」。

examples.en: We discussed why a complete but late order failed the on-time in-full delivery measure.
examples.zh: 我们讨论了为什么送齐却迟到的订单不符合「准时足量交付」指标。

words.enDefinition: Finishing stage preparing an edited sequence at the required technical quality

examples.en: The online edit replaces the smaller versions with the full-quality images for delivery.
examples.zh: 「在线精编」用完整画质的画面替换较小的版本，以便交付。

examples.en: We scheduled the online edit after the class agreed on the final scene order.
examples.zh: 课堂小组确定最终场次顺序后，我们安排了「在线精编」。

words.enDefinition: A signed opinion article, often contributed by someone outside a publication's editorial board.

examples.en: The student paper published an op-ed in which a librarian argued for keeping the reading room open later.
examples.zh: 学生报刊登了一篇「署名评论文章」，一名图书管理员在文中主张延长阅览室开放时间。

examples.en: Our editor labeled the piece an op-ed to make its argument distinct from the day's news coverage.
examples.zh: 编辑把这篇文章标为「署名评论文章」，让读者能将文章观点与当天新闻报道区分开。

words.enDefinition: An interview question inviting a developed answer in the respondent's own words.

examples.en: The reporter asked an open-ended interview question about how the workshop affected the student's daily routine.
examples.zh: 记者提了一个「开放式采访问题」，请学生谈谈工作坊怎样影响了自己的日常安排。

examples.en: We replaced the yes-or-no prompt with an open-ended interview question that invited a specific example.
examples.zh: 我们把只能答是或否的问题换成一个「开放式采访问题」，请受访者举出具体例子。

collocations: an open-ended interview question about an experience

words.enDefinition: A recurring signed article series in which a writer presents personal argument or interpretation.

examples.en: The weekly opinion column discussed study spaces from the writer's own perspective and cited several public reports.
examples.zh: 每周「评论专栏」从作者个人角度讨论学习空间，并引用了几份公开报告。

examples.en: We marked the opinion column clearly so readers knew whose argument they were reading in the newspaper.
examples.zh: 我们为「评论专栏」加上清楚的标识，让读者在报纸上读到观点时知道作者是谁。

words.enDefinition: Setting separate prices for optional additions alongside a core product price

examples.en: The case illustrates optional-product pricing by listing the carrying case separately from the device.
examples.zh: 案例将收纳包与设备分开列价，以说明「可选配件定价」。

examples.en: We checked which items were optional before discussing optional-product pricing in the workbook.
examples.zh: 练习册讨论「可选配件定价」之前，我们先确认哪些商品是可选的。

words.enDefinition: Proportion of orders fulfilled completely from available stock

examples.en: The case counts only complete orders when reporting its order fill rate for the month.
examples.zh: 案例报告当月「订单满足率」时，分子只计能够全量满足的订单。

examples.en: We distinguished order fill rate from the percentage of individual units filled from stock.
examples.zh: 我们将「订单满足率」与各件商品中能从库存满足的比例区分开来。

words.enDefinition: Assigning an order to a location that will prepare or fulfill it

examples.en: The diagram shows order routing assigning the fictional order to a nearby store.
examples.zh: 图示中，「订单分派」将虚构订单分配给附近一家门店。

examples.en: We compared order routing rules based on stock availability and fulfillment distance.
examples.zh: 我们比较了依库存可用性和履约距离分配订单的「订单分派」规则。

words.enDefinition: The first known posting of a specific item online rather than a later repost.

examples.en: The student reporters found the original upload on the public webpage for last year's campus exhibition.
examples.zh: 学生记者在去年校园展览的公开网页上找到了「最初上传版本」。

examples.en: We compared the date of the original upload with the newer date shown on the repost.
examples.zh: 我们将「最初上传版本」的日期与转发页面上较晚的日期作比较。

collocations: compare a repost with the original upload

words.enDefinition: A genuine image shown with surrounding information that misrepresents what it depicts.

examples.en: The fact-check identified an out-of-context image after finding it in a public report about a different workshop.
examples.zh: 事实核查在另一场工作坊的公开报道中找到同一张图，据此确认那是张「脱离原语境的图片」。

examples.en: Our editor rejected the out-of-context image because it did not show the event named in the draft.
examples.zh: 编辑退回了那张「脱离原语境的图片」，因为它拍的不是草稿所指的活动。

words.enDefinition: advertising displayed in public places for people to see while away from home

examples.en: The arts festival used out-of-home advertising near stations and pedestrian routes leading to the venue.
examples.zh: 艺术节在车站附近和通往场馆的人行路线上投放了「户外广告」。

examples.en: Our class considered viewing distance when reviewing out-of-home advertising for the winter exhibition.
examples.zh: 课堂评审冬季展览的「户外广告」时，考虑了观看距离。

words.zhGloss: 系列作品打包发行协议
words.enDefinition: Agreement covering a production supplier's specified output over an agreed period
acceptedZhAnswers: 系列作品打包发行协议

examples.en: The fictional distributor signs an output deal covering several future films from one producer.
examples.zh: 虚构发行商签订了一项「系列作品打包发行协议」，涵盖同一制片人未来的几部影片。

examples.en: We compared the output deal with a contract limited to one completed film.
examples.zh: 我们将「系列作品打包发行协议」与仅涵盖一部成片的合同作了比较。

collocations: titles covered by an output deal

words.enDefinition: Shot framing a subject with another person's shoulder in the foreground

examples.en: The over-the-shoulder shot frames the speaker behind the listener's shoulder in the foreground.
examples.zh: 「过肩镜头」将听者的肩膀放在前景，拍摄肩后说话的人。

examples.en: We tried an over-the-shoulder shot to show the exchange without losing its spatial context.
examples.zh: 我们试拍了一个「过肩镜头」，以保留两人对话时的空间关系。

words.enDefinition: Next-day audience estimates incorporating live and eligible same-day playback in UK Barb reporting

examples.en: The Barb example includes same-day playback in the overnight ratings reported next morning.
examples.zh: Barb 示例把当天回放也计入第二天上午报告的「次日初步收视数据」。

examples.en: We compared the overnight ratings with the later totals for the fictional broadcast.
examples.zh: 我们将「次日初步收视数据」与该虚构节目之后的累计数据作了比较。

words.enDefinition: communication channels directly controlled by the organization publishing through them

examples.en: The school used its newsletter as owned media to share updated details about the ceremony.
examples.zh: 学校把通讯作为「自有媒体」，分享典礼的最新信息。

examples.en: The gallery announced its new hours on owned media such as its website and mailing list.
examples.zh: 美术馆通过网站和邮件列表等「自有媒体」公布新开放时间。

words.enDefinition: Planning a product's packaging for protection, use, and communication.

examples.en: The package design case compared two closures to see which was easier to reopen after use.
examples.zh: 「包装设计」案例比较两种封口，看看用过之后哪种更容易重新打开。

examples.en: We presented a package design that made the fictional refill easier to recognize on the shelf.
examples.zh: 我们展示了一种「包装设计」，让顾客在货架上更容易认出虚构的补充装。

words.enDefinition: a carefully composed image or shot of a product, often showing its packaging and brand identification

examples.en: The video ends with a packshot showing the tea box and its clearly printed label.
examples.zh: 视频最后用了一个「产品展示镜头」，展示茶盒和清晰的标签。

examples.en: The photographer moved the lamp to reduce glare across the product label in the packshot.
examples.zh: 摄影师移动灯光，减少「产品展示镜头」中商品标签的反光。

words.enDefinition: communication space, time, or distribution that an organization purchases from an external channel

examples.en: The festival used paid media to place a short announcement in the local newspaper.
examples.zh: 艺术节通过「付费媒体」在当地报纸上刊登了一则简短公告。

examples.en: The budget worksheet set aside funds for paid media placements during the exhibition opening week.
examples.zh: 预算表为展览开幕周的「付费媒体」投放预留了经费。

words.enDefinition: A test asking participants to compare two presented options directly according to a stated criterion.

examples.en: The fictional paired comparison test reports how many people preferred one folder over the other for portability.
examples.zh: 虚构「成对比较测试」报告了有多少人从便携性出发更喜欢其中一个文件夹。

examples.en: Our seminar distinguishes a paired comparison test from separate ratings of unrelated ideas in the other example.
examples.zh: 研讨课区分了「成对比较测试」与另一示例中对彼此无关的构想分别打分的做法。

collocations: results of a paired comparison test
criterion in a paired comparison test

words.enDefinition: Adjusting participants' contributions so aggregate panel estimates better reflect the target population

examples.en: The classroom report explains panel weighting before publishing estimates for the simulated audience.
examples.zh: 课堂报告先解释「样本组加权」，再公布模拟受众的估计值。

examples.en: Our group compared the aggregate figures before and after panel weighting in class.
examples.zh: 我们组在课堂上比较了「样本组加权」前后的汇总数据。

words.enDefinition: An existing brand whose name or reputation supports an extension or related brand.

examples.en: Buyers in the case recognized the parent brand even though they had never seen the new product.
examples.zh: 尽管从未见过这款新产品，案例中的买家还是认出了「母品牌」。

examples.en: We identified the parent brand before discussing whether its association with durability would transfer to the extension.
examples.zh: 我们先辨认出「母品牌」，再讨论顾客对它的耐用印象能否转移到延伸产品上。

collocations: a link to the parent brand

words.enDefinition: A short, exact portion of someone's words quoted within a larger sentence.

examples.en: The draft used a partial quotation around the speaker's distinctive phrase rather than the whole answer.
examples.zh: 草稿只给说话者有辨识度的短语加了「部分引语」，没有全文照引回答。

examples.en: We checked the partial quotation against the transcript to make sure the excerpt had kept its meaning.
examples.zh: 我们对照文字记录核查「部分引语」，确保摘出的文字仍保留原意。

collocations: weave a partial quotation into the text

words.enDefinition: Television channels or packages accessed through a paid service subscription

examples.en: The case assigns one window to pay television after the cinema run ends.
examples.zh: 案例在影院放映结束后给「付费电视」安排了一个发行窗口。

examples.en: We separated pay television from the free channels in the fictional service comparison.
examples.zh: 我们在虚构服务对比中，将「付费电视」与免费频道分开列出。

words.enDefinition: An amount expressed per person or per fixed number of people in a population.

examples.en: The report used a per capita rate to compare visits in districts with different populations.
examples.zh: 报道用「按人口计算的比率」比较不同人口规模地区的到访次数。

examples.en: We checked that each per capita rate used the same population definition before comparing the districts.
examples.zh: 比较各地区前，我们核对各项「按人口计算的比率」所用的人口定义是否相同。

words.enDefinition: The extent to which respondents see a proposed product idea as different from alternatives they know.

examples.en: The fictional concept report presents perceived concept uniqueness alongside a separate measure of how attractive each idea seems.
examples.zh: 虚构概念报告将「感知产品概念独特性」与对各构想吸引力的单独衡量并排列出。

examples.en: Our class discusses whether perceived concept uniqueness can differ by familiarity with the category in the fictional study.
examples.zh: 全班讨论在虚构研究中，「感知产品概念独特性」是否会因品类熟悉程度而异。

words.enDefinition: A consumer's judgement of the overall quality or excellence of an offering.

examples.en: The survey vignette compares perceived quality ratings from buyers using identical fictional products in different settings.
examples.zh: 调查材料比较了在不同情境下使用同样虚构产品的买家所给出的「感知质量」评分。

examples.en: Our class asks why perceived quality in the survey may differ from an independent assessment of durability.
examples.zh: 全班讨论调查中的「感知质量」为何可能与独立的耐用性评估不同。

words.enDefinition: The uncertainty and potential negative consequences a consumer associates with a possible purchase.

examples.en: The fictional shopper describes perceived risk as uncertainty about whether a storage box will fit the shelf.
examples.zh: 虚构购物者所说的「感知风险」，是无法确定储物盒能否放上架子。

examples.en: Our worksheet compares perceived risk across purchases involving similar prices but different consequences if the item disappoints.
examples.zh: 练习单比较了价格相近、但物品不尽如人意时后果不同的购买案例中的「感知风险」。

words.enDefinition: The consumer's assessment of what an option offers relative to its cost, effort, or other sacrifices.

examples.en: The class compares perceived value across two fictional folders with different prices and expected years of use.
examples.zh: 全班比较预计使用年限和价格不同的两个虚构文件夹的「感知价值」。

examples.en: Our worksheet distinguishes perceived value from the price recorded for the product in the sample catalogue.
examples.zh: 练习单把「感知价值」与样本目录所记载的产品价格区分开。

words.enDefinition: a budgeting approach that sets advertising spending as a percentage of past or projected sales

examples.en: The company used the percentage-of-sales method to calculate next year's advertising allocation from projected revenue.
examples.zh: 公司用「销售额百分比预算法」从预计收入算出下一年度分配给广告的预算。

examples.en: The class examined how a weak sales year could reduce spending under the percentage-of-sales method.
examples.zh: 课堂分析在「销售额百分比预算法」下，销售较弱的一年怎样导致广告开支降低。

words.enDefinition: A diagram showing how customers perceive competing offerings along selected dimensions.

examples.en: The team placed each fictional brand on a perceptual map of durability and ease of carrying.
examples.zh: 小组把每个虚构品牌标在以耐用性和便携性为维度的「知觉定位图」上。

examples.en: We read the perceptual map to see which two product lines were perceived as most alike.
examples.zh: 我们解读「知觉定位图」，查看顾客认为哪两条产品线最相似。

collocations: plot brands on a perceptual map

words.enDefinition: Share of orders delivered complete, on time, undamaged, and with accurate documentation

examples.en: The sample dashboard reports perfect order rate alongside the measure for timely delivery alone.
examples.zh: 样本仪表板将「完美订单率」和仅衡量及时送达的指标一同报告。

examples.en: We identified a missing document that lowered the perfect order rate in the fictional example.
examples.zh: 我们找出了虚构例子里导致「完美订单率」降低的一份缺失单据。

words.enDefinition: advertising primarily intended to change preferences or encourage a choice in favor of an offering

examples.en: The campaign used persuasive advertising to encourage commuters to choose the bus for short journeys.
examples.zh: 这项活动用「说服性广告」鼓励通勤者在短途出行时选择公交。

examples.en: The students identified persuasive advertising in a sample that invited listeners to switch membership plans.
examples.zh: 样本鼓励听众更换会员方案，学生将它识别为「说服性广告」。

words.enDefinition: A communication framework grouping channels or activities as paid, earned, shared, and owned media.

examples.en: The seminar introduces the PESO model by classifying several fictional examples of work for a university exhibition.
examples.zh: 研讨课对大学展览的几个虚构传播案例作分类，以介绍「PESO传播渠道模型」。

examples.en: Our worksheet uses the PESO model to distinguish independent news coverage from notices published by the museum itself.
examples.zh: 练习单用「PESO传播渠道模型」区分独立新闻报道与博物馆自行发布的通知。

words.enDefinition: Rebuilding an approved edit using corresponding full-quality source material

examples.en: During the picture conform, the finishing editor reconnects shots to their source files.
examples.zh: 做「画面套底」时，后期精编师将镜头重新连接到源文件。

examples.en: We checked one missing shot during the picture conform for the student film.
examples.zh: 给学生影片做「画面套底」时，我们核对了一个缺失的镜头。

words.enDefinition: Milestone when shot choices and timings are approved and stop changing

examples.en: The group reaches picture lock before finishing the final sound and subtitle timing.
examples.zh: 小组先完成「画面锁定」，再定稿混音和字幕的时间点。

examples.en: We confirmed picture lock so the sound editor could work against consistent timings.
examples.zh: 我们确认已完成「画面锁定」，让声音剪辑师能按稳定的时间点工作。

words.enDefinition: Commission authorizing production of a sample episode for a proposed series

examples.en: The fictional network issues a pilot order before deciding whether to commission a series.
examples.zh: 虚构电视网先下达「试播集制作订单」，再决定是否委托制作整部剧。

examples.en: Our worksheet distinguishes the pilot order from a commitment to make a season.
examples.zh: 我们的习题把「试播集制作订单」和承诺制作整季区分开来。

words.enDefinition: Script for a sample episode designed to establish a proposed series

examples.en: The pilot script introduces the main setting and two recurring characters in the series.
examples.zh: 「试播集剧本」介绍了该剧的主要场景和两个常驻角色。

examples.en: Our group read the pilot script aloud before discussing the proposed first season.
examples.zh: 我们组先朗读「试播集剧本」，再讨论拟制作的第一季。

words.enDefinition: Deliberately limiting a product's useful or desirable life to encourage replacement.

examples.en: The class discussed planned obsolescence when a fictional case described products designed for unusually frequent replacement.
examples.zh: 一个虚构案例提到，产品被刻意设计成需要频繁更换，全班据此讨论了「计划性淘汰」。

examples.en: We asked what evidence would distinguish planned obsolescence from an unintended design flaw in the classroom case.
examples.zh: 我们问，课堂案例中什么证据能将「计划性淘汰」与无心造成的设计缺陷区分开。

words.enDefinition: Diagram specifying where products should be placed on retail shelves

examples.en: The workbook includes a planogram showing where each product belongs on the shelf.
examples.zh: 练习册有一张「货架陈列图」，标出了各项商品在货架上的位置。

examples.en: We used the planogram to check where the larger packages had been placed.
examples.zh: 我们借助「货架陈列图」查看大包装商品放在了哪里。

words.enDefinition: Initial cinema release in select markets followed by gradual expansion

examples.en: Our platform release scenario starts in a few cinemas before adding other cities.
examples.zh: 我们的「渐进式院线发行」情境从少数影院开始，之后扩展到其他城市。

examples.en: We compared a platform release with an opening that used every booked location.
examples.zh: 我们把「渐进式院线发行」与一开始就在所有预订场地放映的安排作了比较。

words.enDefinition: A relevant attribute or benefit customers strongly associate with one brand over competitors.

examples.en: The replaceable cover gave the fictional notebook a point of difference because comparable brands offered fixed covers.
examples.zh: 类似品牌都提供固定封皮，可更换封皮因此成了虚构笔记本的一个「差异点」。

examples.en: We tested whether the proposed point of difference mattered to students before using it in the assignment.
examples.zh: 我们先了解提出的「差异点」对学生是否重要，再把它写进作业。

words.enDefinition: An association or benefit a brand shares with other credible offerings in its competitive context.

examples.en: Both fictional stationery brands offered spare covers, so the worksheet marked this as a point of parity.
examples.zh: 两个虚构文具品牌都供应备用封皮，所以习题把这一点标为「对等点」。

examples.en: We identified a point of parity before discussing which features actually made the new planner distinctive.
examples.zh: 我们先找出一个「对等点」，再讨论哪些功能真正让这款新计划本与众不同。

words.enDefinition: A choice made in the setting where a purchase occurs, including one made after arriving with an earlier plan.

examples.en: The fictional shopper makes a point-of-purchase decision after seeing the two notebook sizes in the campus shop.
examples.zh: 虚构购物者在校园商店看到两种尺寸的笔记本后，作出一项「购买现场作出的决策」。

examples.en: Our case distinguishes a point-of-purchase decision about colour from the earlier plan to buy a folder.
examples.zh: 案例区分选择颜色这一项「购买现场作出的决策」和先前购买文件夹的计划。

words.enDefinition: a promotional display placed where customers encounter or select goods in a retail setting

examples.en: The bookstore added a point-of-purchase display near the register for books by visiting authors.
examples.zh: 书店在收银台附近加了「购买现场宣传陈列」，展示来访作者的作品。

examples.en: The design students built a point-of-purchase display that left the prices and titles easy to read.
examples.zh: 设计专业学生做了一个「购买现场宣传陈列」，让价格和书名清楚可读。

words.enDefinition: Stock made jointly available to satisfy demand from several outlets or channels

examples.en: The fictional retailer uses pooled inventory for both store purchases and online orders.
examples.zh: 虚构零售商为门店购买和线上订单使用同一份「共享库存」。

examples.en: We compared pooled inventory with a design that holds separate stock for each channel.
examples.zh: 我们将「共享库存」与每个渠道各自储备库存的方案作了比较。

words.enDefinition: Selling through a temporary physical location for a limited period

examples.en: The case uses pop-up retailing for a weekend display of student-made stationery.
examples.zh: 案例用「快闪零售」开展持续一个周末的学生自制文具展售。

examples.en: We compared pop-up retailing with a longer lease in the fictional shopping center.
examples.zh: 我们比较了在虚构购物中心开展「快闪零售」和签订更长期租约的做法。

words.enDefinition: A concise description of an offering's target customers, competitive context, and distinct value.

examples.en: Our positioning statement described who needed the compact lamp and what made it different from comparable models.
examples.zh: 我们的「定位陈述」说明了谁需要这款小台灯，以及它有别于类似型号的地方。

examples.en: We read the positioning statement aloud to see whether it made the intended benefit clear.
examples.zh: 我们大声读出「定位陈述」，看它是否说清了主打的利益。

words.enDefinition: In satisfaction research, a comparison in which experienced performance exceeds the consumer's prior expectations.

examples.en: The fictional report illustrates positive disconfirmation when the folder holds more materials than the buyer originally expected.
examples.zh: 虚构报告中文件夹能装下的材料比买家最初预期更多，体现「实际表现超出预期」。

examples.en: Our classroom chart represents positive disconfirmation with a performance rating above the expectation rating in the example.
examples.zh: 课堂图在示例中用高于预期评分的表现评分表示「实际表现超出预期」。

words.enDefinition: An assessment after an incident of how communication worked and which practices could be improved.

examples.en: The post-incident communications review compares when fictional updates were published with when residents reported receiving the information.
examples.zh: 「事件后沟通复盘」将虚构通报的发布时间与居民报告收到信息的时间作比较。

examples.en: Our class asks which communication lessons are supported by the evidence listed in the post-incident communications review.
examples.zh: 全班询问，「事件后沟通复盘」所列证据支持哪些沟通方面的经验教训。

collocations: findings of a post-incident communications review
recommendations from a post-incident communications review

words.enDefinition: a video or audio advertisement played after the main content ends

examples.en: The film ends with credits before a post-roll ad announces the next festival screening.
examples.zh: 影片字幕播完后，一则「后贴广告」公布电影节下一场放映。

examples.en: The report compared post-roll ad viewers with the number of people who started the video.
examples.zh: 报告把看到「后贴广告」的人数与开始观看视频的人数作比较。

words.enDefinition: A consumer's assessment of a purchase after acquiring or using the product or service.

examples.en: The case illustrates postpurchase evaluation when a fictional student reflects on how the notebook performed during class.
examples.zh: 案例通过虚构学生回顾笔记本在上课时的使用表现来说明「购后评价」。

examples.en: Our discussion separates postpurchase evaluation from the information the fictional shopper collected before choosing the item.
examples.zh: 讨论将「购后评价」与虚构购物者选择该物品前收集的信息区分开来。

words.enDefinition: Possible future improvements and additions to an offering.

examples.en: The potential product in our case included a replacement cover that the current notebook lacked.
examples.zh: 我们案例中的「潜在产品层」包括当前笔记本尚未配备的可替换封皮。

examples.en: The team put future customization ideas under the potential product on its classroom product map.
examples.zh: 小组在课堂产品示意图上，将未来可做的定制项目归入「潜在产品层」。

words.enDefinition: An estimate of the audience that might have encountered coverage, based on source audience figures or other stated assumptions.

examples.en: The fictional report labels potential reach of coverage as an estimate based on readership figures for the outlets.
examples.zh: 虚构报告将「报道的潜在触达人数」标注为根据相关媒体读者量得出的估计。

examples.en: Our worksheet compares potential reach of coverage with direct evidence about what fictional readers actually saw.
examples.zh: 练习单将「报道的潜在触达人数」与有关虚构读者实际看到哪些内容的直接证据进行比较。

collocations: assumptions behind potential reach of coverage

words.enDefinition: An external firm providing public relations planning, media work, or related communication services to clients.

examples.en: The casebook describes a PR agency hired to support the fictional gallery's public opening programme for residents.
examples.zh: 案例教材描述了一家受雇协助虚构画廊开展居民开放项目的「公关代理机构」。

examples.en: Our class compares the PR agency's proposed role with the work the fictional gallery keeps in house.
examples.zh: 全班将「公关代理机构」拟承担的工作与虚构画廊留在机构内部处理的工作作比较。

words.enDefinition: A coordinated programme of public relations work with a defined purpose, audience, and period or set of activities.

examples.en: The fictional museum runs a PR campaign to explain new opening hours before the semester begins.
examples.zh: 虚构博物馆开展一项「公关活动」，在学期开始之前说明新的开放时间。

examples.en: Our seminar separates the PR campaign from the one announcement used to introduce the library programme.
examples.zh: 研讨课把整项「公关活动」与介绍图书馆项目的那份公告区分开。

words.enDefinition: Principles and professional standards guiding honest, responsible, and transparent public relations practice.

examples.en: The seminar introduces PR ethics by asking what a fictional organisation should disclose about a funded exhibition.
examples.zh: 研讨课讨论虚构机构应公开一场受资助展览的哪些信息，以介绍「公共关系职业伦理」。

examples.en: Our casebook connects PR ethics with correcting an error in a public notice once it is discovered.
examples.zh: 案例教材把「公共关系职业伦理」与发现公众通知有误后作出更正联系起来。

words.enDefinition: A structured approach connecting public relations objectives with indicators of activities, responses, and relevant effects.

examples.en: The fictional museum's PR measurement framework links published notices to separate measures of understanding among the intended audiences.
examples.zh: 虚构博物馆的「公关测量框架」将发布的通知与面向预定受众的理解程度指标相联系。

examples.en: Our exercise uses a PR measurement framework to distinguish audience response from the number of notices published.
examples.zh: 练习用「公关测量框架」区分受众反应与发布通知的数量。

collocations: indicators in a PR measurement framework

words.enDefinition: Phase in which a screen project is planned and prepared before filming

examples.en: The group booked rehearsal space and checked locations during pre-production for the film.
examples.zh: 小组在影片「拍摄前筹备」阶段预订了排练场地，并查看拍摄地点。

examples.en: Our schedule separates pre-production from the weeks assigned to actual filming.
examples.zh: 我们把「拍摄前筹备」和实际拍摄所占的几周分开排期。

words.enDefinition: a video or audio advertisement played before the main content begins

examples.en: A short pre-roll ad introduced the sponsor before the documentary began on the festival website.
examples.zh: 纪录片在电影节网站开播前，一则简短的「前贴广告」介绍了赞助方。

examples.en: The producers checked whether the pre-roll ad ended cleanly before the interview title appeared.
examples.zh: 制作组确认「前贴广告」是否在访谈标题出现前顺畅结束。

words.enDefinition: Agreement licensing distribution rights before a screen project is completed

examples.en: The fictional producer enters a pre-sale agreement before completing the feature film.
examples.zh: 虚构制片人在长片完成之前订立了「发行权预售协议」。

examples.en: We identified when the pre-sale agreement was signed on the production finance timeline.
examples.zh: 我们在制作融资时间线上确定了「发行权预售协议」的签署时间。

collocations: finance supported by a pre-sale agreement

words.enDefinition: Words drafted before a person delivers them in a speech, statement, or briefing.

examples.en: The fictional director's prepared remarks describe the project before the media ask about the library's collection.
examples.zh: 虚构总监的「预先准备的发言稿」先介绍项目，随后媒体再问到馆藏。

examples.en: Our exercise compares the prepared remarks with the additional comments in the fictional briefing transcript.
examples.zh: 练习把「预先准备的发言稿」与虚构说明会记录中的补充发言作比较。

words.enDefinition: Beliefs a consumer holds before buying about the performance or experience a product or service will provide.

examples.en: The fictional diary records prepurchase expectations about how much space the new container would provide during use.
examples.zh: 虚构日记记下了关于新容器使用时能提供多少空间的「购买前预期」。

examples.en: Our class compared prepurchase expectations with the experience described after several uses of the fictional product.
examples.zh: 我们把「购买前预期」与虚构产品用过几次之后所描述的体验作比较。

words.enDefinition: A meeting or session in which an organisation gives journalists information and may answer questions about a particular topic.

examples.en: The fictional university holds a press briefing to explain how the temporary reading room will operate.
examples.zh: 虚构大学举办「媒体情况说明会」，解释临时阅览室将怎样运行。

examples.en: Our exercise distinguishes the press briefing from the short written notice sent before the fictional event.
examples.zh: 练习区分了「媒体情况说明会」和虚构活动开始前发出的简短书面通知。

words.enDefinition: Documents or badges that identify a person's press role or show authorisation to cover an event.

examples.en: The fictional event notes say that press credentials identify journalists admitted to the media preview session.
examples.zh: 虚构活动说明写道，「媒体采访证件」用于识别获准参加媒体预览的记者。

examples.en: Our worksheet separates press credentials from the public visitor passes shown in the fictional event guide.
examples.zh: 练习单把「媒体采访证件」与虚构活动指南展示的公众访客通行证分开。

words.enDefinition: An invitation asking members of the press to attend an event or related media opportunity.

examples.en: The fictional gallery sends a press invitation for the morning preview rather than the evening public reception.
examples.zh: 虚构画廊发出的「媒体采访邀请」针对上午预览，而非晚间公众招待会。

examples.en: Our class reads the press invitation to identify which part of the fictional event journalists may attend.
examples.zh: 全班阅读「媒体采访邀请」，找出记者可以参加虚构活动的哪个环节。

words.enDefinition: A collection of materials that an organisation makes available to journalists, such as background information and approved images.

examples.en: The fictional gallery's press kit includes a description of the exhibition and several approved photographs for publication.
examples.zh: 虚构画廊的「媒体资料包」包含展览说明及几张已获准发表的照片。

examples.en: Our seminar identifies which item in the press kit gives reporters general background about the fictional institution.
examples.zh: 研讨课辨认「媒体资料包」中哪件材料向记者介绍虚构机构的一般背景。

collocations: include a fact sheet in a press kit

words.enDefinition: An organisational unit that handles enquiries from journalists and coordinates media communication.

examples.en: The fictional college directs reporters to its press office for questions about the new reading room's opening.
examples.zh: 虚构大学请记者向其「新闻联络办公室」咨询新阅览室的开放事宜。

examples.en: Our sample website places the press office address beside the section containing official announcements and media contacts.
examples.zh: 样本网站把「新闻联络办公室」地址放在收录正式公告和媒体联络人的栏目旁。

words.enDefinition: A staff member responsible for dealing with journalists and coordinating an organisation's press enquiries or statements.

examples.en: The fictional press officer checks which department can answer a reporter's question about the revised museum opening.
examples.zh: 虚构的「新闻联络专员」核对哪个部门能回答记者关于博物馆新开放时间的问题。

examples.en: Our worksheet asks who acts as press officer at the fictional institution when the usual contact is absent.
examples.zh: 练习单询问，在常用联系人缺席时，虚构机构由谁担任「新闻联络专员」。

words.enDefinition: A written announcement supplied by an organisation to the media to communicate news or other public information.

examples.en: The fictional museum issues a press release announcing the exhibition dates and the opening hours for visitors.
examples.zh: 虚构博物馆发布一篇「公关新闻稿」，宣布展览日期和对访客开放的时段。

examples.en: Our casebook compares the press release with the separate report written by the fictional local newspaper.
examples.zh: 案例教材将「公关新闻稿」与虚构本地报纸另行撰写的报道作比较。

words.enDefinition: A collection that preserves past releases and makes them available for reference.

examples.en: The fictional institution's press release archive contains past opening dates announced over several terms of the exhibition.
examples.zh: 虚构机构的「公关新闻稿档案库」保存了几学期展览期间曾公布的开放日期。

examples.en: Our classroom exercise uses the press release archive to locate the first public reference to the project.
examples.zh: 课堂练习用「公关新闻稿档案库」查找有关项目的最早公开提法。

collocations: records in a press release archive

words.zhGloss: 公关新闻稿固定机构简介
words.enDefinition: A reusable section of a press release that provides standard background information about the issuing organisation.
acceptedZhAnswers: 公关新闻稿固定机构简介

examples.en: The fictional gallery includes its mission and founding year in the press release boilerplate below the announcement.
examples.zh: 虚构画廊在公告下方的「公关新闻稿固定机构简介」中列出使命与创立年份。

examples.en: Our worksheet asks which details belong in the press release boilerplate rather than in the changing announcement.
examples.zh: 练习单询问，哪些细节应该放进「公关新闻稿固定机构简介」，而不是放进随事件变化的公告内容。

words.zhGloss: 公关新闻稿发稿地点与日期行
words.enDefinition: A line commonly giving the place and date of issue at the beginning of a press release.
acceptedZhAnswers: 公关新闻稿发稿地点与日期行

examples.en: The sample press release dateline gives a fictional city name and the date of the museum announcement.
examples.zh: 样本「公关新闻稿发稿地点与日期行」给出一个虚构城市的名称和博物馆公告的日期。

examples.en: Our worksheet separates the press release dateline from the dates of the exhibition described in the announcement.
examples.zh: 练习单将「公关新闻稿发稿地点与日期行」与公告正文里的展览日期区分开。

collocations: date in a press release dateline
format of a press release dateline

words.zhGloss: 向媒体分发公关新闻稿
words.enDefinition: Making a press release available to relevant media outlets or recipients through an established service or channel.
acceptedZhAnswers: 向媒体分发公关新闻稿

examples.en: The sample plan lists press release distribution as a separate task from editing the announcement's first draft.
examples.zh: 样本计划把「向媒体分发公关新闻稿」和编辑公告初稿分列为两项工作。

examples.en: Our fictional timetable assigns press release distribution to the same office that posts the library's announcements.
examples.zh: 虚构日程把「向媒体分发公关新闻稿」交给同一个负责发布图书馆公告的部门。

words.enDefinition: The title at the top of an organisation's press release, summarising the main announcement.

examples.en: The press release headline names the fictional gallery's reopening, while the first paragraph gives the date.
examples.zh: 「公关新闻稿标题」提到虚构画廊重新开放，第一段则给出日期。

examples.en: Our class checks whether the press release headline reflects the announcement described in the body text.
examples.zh: 全班核对「公关新闻稿标题」是否对应正文所述的公告内容。

words.enDefinition: The opening paragraph or sentence of a press release that presents its main news or point.

examples.en: The press release lead specifies when the fictional reading room will open and who can use it.
examples.zh: 「公关新闻稿导语」写明虚构阅览室何时开放、哪些人可以使用。

examples.en: Our tutor asks which essential information appears in the press release lead and which comes later.
examples.zh: 老师询问，哪些核心信息出现在「公关新闻稿导语」里，哪些留到后文。

collocations: details in the press release lead

words.enDefinition: Setting a high price partly to signal quality, exclusivity, or status

examples.en: The case illustrates prestige pricing for a fictional limited series of desk accessories.
examples.zh: 案例用一套虚构的限量桌面用品来说明「声望定价」。

examples.en: We discussed prestige pricing when the high price itself was part of the signal.
examples.zh: 当高价本身就是信号的一部分时，我们讨论了「声望定价」。

words.enDefinition: Condition that determines which customers or transactions qualify for a price

examples.en: The case labels the difference in refund flexibility as a price fence.
examples.zh: 案例把退款灵活性的差别标为一项「价格区隔条件」。

examples.en: We discussed whether the price fence was clear in the example's price table.
examples.zh: 我们讨论了示例价目表中的「价格区隔条件」是否清楚。

words.enDefinition: Grouping assorted merchandise at a limited set of distinct price points

examples.en: The classroom retailer uses price lining to group notebooks at three set prices.
examples.zh: 课堂案例里的零售商采用「分档定价」，把笔记本分到三个固定价位。

examples.en: We compared price lining with a price list using a different amount for every item.
examples.zh: 我们把「分档定价」与每件商品各自定一个金额的价目表作了比较。

words.enDefinition: Design of package sizes and their corresponding price points within an assortment

examples.en: The exercise uses price-pack architecture to compare prices for three package sizes.
examples.zh: 练习用「包装规格价格体系」比较三种包装规格的价格。

examples.en: Our group mapped the price-pack architecture for a fictional range of stationery packs.
examples.zh: 我们组绘制了一套虚构文具套装的「包装规格价格体系」。

words.enDefinition: Ratio of actual net transaction prices to stated or targeted prices

examples.en: The sample report shows price realization below the target despite an advertised increase.
examples.zh: 样本报告显示，虽然公告已提价，「实际价格达成率」仍低于目标。

examples.en: We discussed price realization after reviewing the net revenue per unit in the case.
examples.zh: 我们查看案例中单位商品的净收入后，讨论了「实际价格达成率」。

words.enDefinition: Introducing an offering at a high price and reducing it over time

examples.en: The mock launch plan uses price skimming and schedules gradual reductions after introduction.
examples.zh: 模拟上市方案采用「撇脂定价」，并安排上市后逐步降价。

examples.en: We compared price skimming with a launch strategy aiming for widespread early adoption.
examples.zh: 我们将「撇脂定价」与旨在上市初期获得广泛采用的策略作了比较。

words.enDefinition: Breakdown showing adjustments from list price to actual net transaction price

examples.en: The price waterfall in the workbook shows how rebates reduce net revenue per sale.
examples.zh: 练习册里的「价格瀑布图」展示了返利如何降低每笔交易的净收入。

examples.en: We traced the two adjustments highlighted in the fictional price waterfall diagram.
examples.zh: 我们追踪了虚构「价格瀑布图」中突出的两项价格调整。

words.enDefinition: Business result a company intends to achieve through its pricing

examples.en: The case identifies the pricing objective before discussing what the product should cost.
examples.zh: 案例先明确「定价目标」，再讨论产品应该定在什么价格。

examples.en: We compared two plans because their stated pricing objective differed from the start.
examples.zh: 我们对比了两项方案，因为它们一开始设定的「定价目标」就不同。

words.enDefinition: Packaging that immediately contains or directly surrounds the product.

examples.en: The sachet touching the tea leaves counted as primary packaging in the classroom design review.
examples.zh: 直接包着茶叶的小袋在课堂设计评审中算作「内包装」。

examples.en: Our group tested whether the primary packaging could be opened easily without damaging the sample item.
examples.zh: 我们小组测试了能否轻松打开「内包装」，同时不弄坏样品。

words.enDefinition: Main period in which the planned scenes for a screen project are filmed

examples.en: The fictional feature begins principal photography after the studio finishes building its main set.
examples.zh: 虚构长片将在摄影棚完成主要布景搭建后开始「主体拍摄」。

examples.en: We marked principal photography separately from the extra filming arranged after the shoot.
examples.zh: 我们把「主体拍摄」和之后另行安排的补拍分开标注。

words.enDefinition: A brand owned or controlled by a retailer and sold as its own offering.

examples.en: The fictional bookstore sold basic pens under a private-label brand carrying the shop's own name.
examples.zh: 虚构书店用印有自身名称的「零售商自有品牌」销售基础款笔。

examples.en: We compared a private-label brand with products sold under their manufacturers' names in the same shop.
examples.zh: 我们把一种「零售商自有品牌」与同店以生产商自己名义销售的产品作比较。

words.enDefinition: advertising primarily intended to promote a specific good or service

examples.en: The publisher ran product advertising for the new workbook in newsletters read by language tutors.
examples.zh: 出版商在语言辅导教师阅读的通讯上刊登了新练习册的「产品广告」。

examples.en: The creative team revised the product advertising to demonstrate the capabilities of one specific camera model.
examples.zh: 创意团队修改了「产品广告」，以展示某个具体相机型号的性能。

collocations: product advertising for a new model

words.enDefinition: A characteristic of an offering that can be described, observed, or judged.

examples.en: The exercise asked which product attribute mattered most when buyers compared the two fictional bags.
examples.zh: 练习问，买家比较两款虚构包袋时，哪项「产品属性」最重要。

examples.en: The group listed a washable lining as a product attribute and easier cleaning as its benefit.
examples.zh: 小组把可洗内衬列为「产品属性」，将更方便清洁列为它带来的利益。

words.enDefinition: A brand identifying a specific product or line of products.

examples.en: The mock company gave its new desk lamp a product brand separate from its corporate name.
examples.zh: 模拟公司为新台灯取了一个独立于公司名称的「产品品牌」。

examples.en: The case used a different product brand for each of two bags made by the same firm.
examples.zh: 案例中，同一家公司生产两款包袋，每款各用一个「产品品牌」。

words.enDefinition: A new offering taking sales away from another product sold by the same business.

examples.en: The class suspected product cannibalization when the new bag sold well but purchases of its predecessor fell.
examples.zh: 新包袋畅销，但上一款的购买量下降，全班怀疑出现了「自家产品销量蚕食」。

examples.en: We checked combined sales before deciding whether the fictional launch had caused product cannibalization.
examples.zh: 我们先核对合计销量，再判断这次虚构上市是否造成了「自家产品销量蚕食」。

words.enDefinition: Permanently ending the supply of a particular product.

examples.en: The fictional company's product discontinuation notice said it would stop supplying the older model next term.
examples.zh: 虚构公司的「停止供应产品」通知说明，下学期起将不再供应旧型号。

examples.en: Students distinguished product discontinuation from temporarily running out of the item in the fictional store.
examples.zh: 学生区分了「停止供应产品」和虚构商店里该商品暂时售罄。

words.enDefinition: A specific offering within a seller's product line or overall selection.

examples.en: The catalogue counted the large sketchbook as one product item within the fictional stationery line.
examples.zh: 产品目录将大号素描本算作虚构文具线中的一项「单项产品」。

examples.en: The class marked each product item separately before totaling the items sold by the mock company.
examples.zh: 全班先分别标出各「单项产品」，再统计模拟公司销售的项目总数。

collocations: a product item in the line

words.enDefinition: A model of sales and market development from introduction through decline.

examples.en: We traced the product life cycle of a fictional desk lamp using a chart of annual sales.
examples.zh: 我们用一张年销量图追踪虚构台灯的「产品生命周期」。

examples.en: The reading showed how the product life cycle could differ between two versions of the same item.
examples.zh: 阅读材料说明，同一产品的不同版本，其「产品生命周期」也可能不同。

collocations: stages of the product life cycle

words.enDefinition: A group of related offerings sold by the same organization.

examples.en: The fictional campus shop put its drawing pads and sketchbooks in a single product line.
examples.zh: 虚构校园商店将画纸本和素描本归入同一条「产品线」。

examples.en: Our group examined the product line to see where another notebook model might fit naturally.
examples.zh: 小组查看了这条「产品线」，看再加入一种笔记本型号是否合适。

words.enDefinition: The number of versions or items offered within a particular product line.

examples.en: The fictional stationery company increased product line depth by adding two new sizes to its notebook range.
examples.zh: 虚构文具公司为笔记本系列增设两种尺寸，提高了「产品线深度」。

examples.en: Our team compared product line depth for two lamp lines with different numbers of finishes and sizes.
examples.zh: 我们比较了两个台灯系列的「产品线深度」，它们各自提供的表面处理和尺寸数量不同。

words.enDefinition: Coordinating prices across related versions or tiers within a product line

examples.en: The mock company uses product line pricing to price three versions of the same lamp.
examples.zh: 模拟公司通过「产品线定价」为同一款灯的三个版本定价。

examples.en: We discussed product line pricing by comparing price gaps between models in the same range.
examples.zh: 我们比较了同一系列各型号的价差，以讨论「产品线定价」。

words.enDefinition: Removing individual offerings from a product line to simplify or strengthen it.

examples.en: The fictional company used product line pruning to remove two versions that met almost identical needs.
examples.zh: 虚构公司通过「产品线精简」，去掉了满足几乎相同需求的两个款式。

examples.en: We considered product line pruning after most fictional customers chose the same two notebook formats.
examples.zh: 当大多数虚构顾客都选择同两种笔记本规格时，我们考虑了「产品线精简」。

collocations: the effect of product line pruning

words.enDefinition: How closely related the product lines are in use, production, distribution, or another relevant dimension.

examples.en: We assessed product mix consistency by checking whether different lines used similar materials or sales outlets.
examples.zh: 我们核对各条产品线是否使用相近材料或销售网点，以评估「产品组合一致性」。

examples.en: The class discussed product mix consistency after noticing that notebooks and pencil cases served the same customers.
examples.zh: 发现笔记本和笔袋服务同一批顾客后，全班讨论了「产品组合一致性」。

collocations: compare firms on product mix consistency

words.enDefinition: The total number of individual items across all product lines.

examples.en: We calculated product mix length by adding the item counts for every line in the fictional catalogue.
examples.zh: 我们将虚构产品目录中各条产品线的项目数量相加，算出「产品组合长度」。

examples.en: Removing two notebook models reduced product mix length even though the number of lines stayed the same.
examples.zh: 尽管产品线条数没变，取消两种笔记本型号仍缩短了「产品组合长度」。

collocations: compare the product mix length of two firms

words.enDefinition: The number of distinct product lines offered by a business.

examples.en: Adding a line of desk lamps increased product mix width in our fictional retail case.
examples.zh: 在虚构零售案例中，增加台灯产品线扩大了「产品组合宽度」。

examples.en: We counted the product lines rather than the individual items to calculate product mix width.
examples.zh: 我们用产品线的数量来计算「产品组合宽度」，没有逐个数其中的单项产品。

words.enDefinition: Changing an existing product's features, quality, or design while retaining the offering.

examples.en: The fictional company tried product modification by adding a replaceable handle to its existing mug.
examples.zh: 虚构公司给原有马克杯加上可更换把手，尝试进行「产品改良」。

examples.en: We compared one product modification with the option of introducing an entirely separate desk accessory.
examples.zh: 我们把一项「产品改良」与新推一款独立桌面用品的方案作比较。

words.enDefinition: A consumer's perceived chance that an option will not work adequately or as expected.

examples.en: The case illustrates product performance risk when a fictional student doubts a folder will hold larger drawings.
examples.zh: 案例用虚构学生不确定文件夹能否装下较大画稿的一幕说明「性能风险」。

examples.en: Our survey summary separates product performance risk from concerns about how much the product costs in the example.
examples.zh: 调查摘要把「性能风险」与示例中对产品价格的顾虑区分开来。

words.enDefinition: A shared set of components or design elements supporting multiple related products.

examples.en: The two desk organizers shared a product platform but came with different trays and dividers.
examples.zh: 两款桌面收纳架共用一个「产品平台」，但配有不同的托盘和隔板。
