words.enDefinition: Master video version without selected on-screen text for creating localized versions

examples.en: The project needs a textless master so each distributor can add translated titles.
examples.zh: 该项目需要一份「无字母版」，让各发行商可以加上译制片名。

examples.en: We checked the textless master to make sure it omitted the original location captions.
examples.zh: 我们检查「无字母版」，确认它删去了原版标明地点的字幕。

words.enDefinition: an advertising pretest in which an audience sees an advertisement in a viewing setting resembling its intended context

examples.en: The researchers showed the short advertisement between programme segments during the theater test last week.
examples.zh: 研究人员在上周的「影院式广告测试」里，把短广告插在节目片段之间播放。

examples.en: The theater test gave the team feedback on a video before the agency bought airtime.
examples.zh: 机构购买播出时段前，团队用「影院式广告测试」收集视频反馈。

words.enDefinition: Period allocated to cinema exhibition within a title's broader release schedule

examples.en: The theatrical window in the example ends before the film arrives on streaming.
examples.zh: 示例中的「院线放映窗口期」在影片上线流媒体之前结束。

examples.en: We marked the theatrical window separately from planned home viewing in the timeline.
examples.zh: 我们在时间线上把「院线放映窗口期」和计划中的家庭观看时段分开标注。

words.enDefinition: Outsourced logistics services provided by an independent specialist business

examples.en: The fictional retailer uses third-party logistics for storage and dispatch during the project.
examples.zh: 虚构零售商在项目中采用「第三方物流」来储存和发运商品。

examples.en: We compared third-party logistics with the retailer managing those operations internally in class.
examples.zh: 我们在课堂上对比了「第三方物流」与零售商自行管理这些业务的做法。

collocations: outsource to a third-party logistics provider

words.enDefinition: A consumer's perceived possibility of wasting time on a purchase or losing time if it goes wrong.

examples.en: The fictional comparison mentions time risk of a purchase if an unsuitable container has to be exchanged later.
examples.zh: 虚构比较提到，如果不合适的容器之后必须换货，就存在「购买中的时间风险」。

examples.en: Our seminar identifies the time risk of a purchase separately from the possible costs described by the shopper.
examples.zh: 研讨课将「购买中的时间风险」与购物者描述的潜在费用分别辨认。

collocations: assess the time risk of a purchase
discuss the time risk of a purchase
perceived time risk of a purchase

words.enDefinition: Watching a scheduled programme after its original broadcast time through later playback

examples.en: The table reports time-shifted viewing separately from watching the programme as it airs.
examples.zh: 表格把「时移观看」和节目播出时同步观看分开报告。

examples.en: We discussed whether watching a recording the next day counted as time-shifted viewing.
examples.zh: 我们讨论了次日观看一份录像是否算「时移观看」。

words.enDefinition: File containing display text and its timing instructions for audiovisual playback

examples.en: The timed text file tells the playback system when each subtitle should appear.
examples.zh: 「时码字幕文件」告诉播放系统每条字幕应在什么时候出现。

examples.en: We checked that the timed text file matched the final version of the picture.
examples.zh: 我们检查了「时码字幕文件」是否与最终版画面匹配。

words.enDefinition: The percentage of respondents selecting the single highest response category on a rating scale.

examples.en: The fictional table reports a top-box score using only the highest response category in the exercise.
examples.zh: 虚构表仅用练习中最高回答档计算「最高档回答占比」。

examples.en: Our seminar checks the respondent base before comparing the top-box score across two fictional product ideas.
examples.zh: 研讨课先核对受访者计算基数，再比较两项虚构产品构想的「最高档回答占比」。

words.enDefinition: In brand surveys, the share of respondents who name a brand first when asked to recall brands in its category.

examples.en: The student team measured top-of-mind awareness by counting which label respondents named first in each category.
examples.zh: 学生小组统计回答者在每个品类首先说出的品牌，以测量「品牌第一提及率」。

examples.en: The fictional brand had high overall recognition but low top-of-mind awareness in the classroom comparison.
examples.zh: 课堂比较中，这个虚构品牌的整体再认表现不错，但「品牌第一提及率」较低。

words.zhGloss: 最高两档回答合计占比
words.enDefinition: The percentage of respondents whose ratings fall in either of the two highest categories on a scale.
acceptedZhAnswers: 最高两档回答合计占比

examples.en: The fictional report combines the highest two categories to calculate the top-two-box score for one proposal.
examples.zh: 虚构报告合并最高的两个类别，计算其中一项提案的「最高两档回答合计占比」。

examples.en: Our class compares the top-two-box score with the share giving only the single highest rating in the table.
examples.zh: 全班将「最高两档回答合计占比」与表中只给出最高分的比例相比较。

words.enDefinition: On-demand viewing model charging separately to rent or purchase individual titles

examples.en: The plan uses transactional video on demand to make the film available for a separate rental charge.
examples.zh: 方案以「单片付费视频点播」模式提供影片，观看者需另付租看费。

examples.en: We compared transactional video on demand with an offer charging a monthly catalogue subscription.
examples.zh: 我们将「单片付费视频点播」和对整个片库按月收费的方案作了比较。

collocations: revenue from transactional video on demand

words.enDefinition: advertising placed on public transportation vehicles or in related places such as stations and shelters

examples.en: The museum chose transit advertising inside buses serving neighborhoods near the new gallery site.
examples.zh: 博物馆选择在通往新展馆附近社区的公交车内投放「公共交通广告」。

examples.en: The media planner compared transit advertising on train platforms with posters inside the vehicles.
examples.zh: 媒体规划人员比较了火车站台与车厢内的「公共交通广告」。

words.enDefinition: The extent to which an innovation can be tried on a limited basis before adoption.

examples.en: The display model improved trialability because students could try one module before choosing the whole kit.
examples.zh: 展示模型提高了「可试用性」，学生可以在选购整套工具之前先试用一个模块。

examples.en: We discussed trialability after comparing two fictional offers that provided different opportunities for hands-on use.
examples.zh: 我们比较了允许不同程度动手体验的两种虚构产品方案，再讨论「可试用性」。

words.enDefinition: Wholesaler selling and delivering goods from a vehicle along a route

examples.en: The case shows a truck wholesaler selling stock to shops along a single route.
examples.zh: 案例展示了一家「车载批发商」沿一条路线向各家商店销售车载商品。

examples.en: We traced the stock sold by the truck wholesaler during its scheduled stops.
examples.zh: 我们追踪了「车载批发商」在安排好的各个停靠点出售的库存。

words.enDefinition: A newsroom policy requiring two sufficiently independent sources for specified information before publication.

examples.en: The fictional newsroom applied its two-source rule before publishing a claim about the library's opening date.
examples.zh: 虚构新闻室在发表图书馆开放日期这一消息之前，使用了自己的「双来源核实规则」。

examples.en: We discussed why repeating one statement in two outlets did not satisfy the classroom two-source rule.
examples.zh: 我们讨论了为什么两个媒体重复同一份声明，并不能满足课堂的「双来源核实规则」。

words.enDefinition: the ability to remember an advertisement without being given identifying prompts

examples.en: The first question measured unaided ad recall without showing any images from the transport campaign.
examples.zh: 第一道问题测量「无提示广告回忆」，没有展示交通宣传活动的任何图片。

examples.en: The class compared unaided ad recall for two advertisements before revealing either campaign's main slogan.
examples.zh: 课堂在揭晓两则广告的主标语前，比较了它们的「无提示广告回忆」。

words.enDefinition: Rights in preexisting material on which a new screen project is based

examples.en: The fictional budget lists payments for underlying rights in the source novel.
examples.zh: 虚构预算列出了购买原著小说「原始素材权利」的支出。

examples.en: We discussed underlying rights before reading the mock deal for the finished film.
examples.zh: 我们先讨论「原始素材权利」，再阅读成片的模拟交易协议。

words.enDefinition: Retail approach using a shared platform and data across selling channels

examples.en: The technology diagram shows unified commerce through one system for inventory and transactions.
examples.zh: 技术示意图通过一个同时管理库存和交易的系统展示了「统一商业系统」。

examples.en: We discussed unified commerce after comparing separate records with a single shared record.
examples.zh: 我们对比分渠道记录与单一共享记录后，讨论了「统一商业系统」。

words.enDefinition: Charging the same delivery-inclusive price regardless of the buyer's covered location

examples.en: The diagram uses uniform delivered pricing for two locations with different underlying delivery costs.
examples.zh: 图表对实际配送成本不同的两个地点采用「统一到货定价」。

examples.en: We compared uniform delivered pricing with a plan charging different amounts by region.
examples.zh: 我们将「统一到货定价」与按地区收取不同金额的方案作了比较。

collocations: contrast uniform delivered pricing with zone prices

words.enDefinition: the number of distinct people exposed to an advertisement or campaign, as estimated or measured

examples.en: The report estimated unique reach by counting each viewer once across all three media placements.
examples.zh: 报告在三个媒体投放位置中只给每位观众计数一次，据此估算「去重触达人数」。

examples.en: The two radio schedules had equal impression totals but different estimates of unique reach.
examples.zh: 两套电台排期的总展示量相同，但「去重触达人数」的估计不同。

words.enDefinition: US production role overseeing a filming unit's budget, scheduling, and off-set logistics

examples.en: The US class example assigns the unit production manager responsibility for the crew's travel arrangements.
examples.zh: 美国课堂案例将摄制组的出行安排交给「摄制组制片主任」。

examples.en: We checked which decisions the unit production manager made about the mock unit's daily budget.
examples.zh: 我们核对了「摄制组制片主任」对模拟摄制组的每日预算作了哪些决定。

collocations: work with a unit production manager
duties of a unit production manager

words.enDefinition: A purchase not intended before a particular shopping visit or decision context.

examples.en: The fictional shopper notices a needed item missing from the list and makes an unplanned purchase.
examples.zh: 虚构购物者注意到清单漏掉了一件需要的用品，于是发生一次「未计划的购买」。

examples.en: Our session explains how an unplanned purchase can result from remembering an earlier need during shopping.
examples.zh: 课堂说明购物时想起先前需求也会引起「未计划的购买」。

words.enDefinition: An offering customers do not know about or ordinarily consider buying.

examples.en: The emergency repair membership was an unsought product for students who rarely thought about broken bicycles.
examples.zh: 对平时很少想到自行车会坏的学生而言，紧急维修会籍属于「非寻求品」。

examples.en: We discussed how an unfamiliar service might be an unsought product even if it met a real need.
examples.zh: 我们讨论，一项陌生服务即使满足实际需求，也可能属于「非寻求品」。

collocations: an example of an unsought product

words.enDefinition: A note identifying new information added after a news report was first published.

examples.en: The update note said that the shuttle service had begun after the initial version of the story appeared.
examples.zh: 「新闻更新说明」写明，初版报道发布后，接驳车服务已经开通。

examples.en: We used an update note to distinguish newly confirmed details from information already in the story.
examples.zh: 我们用「新闻更新说明」区分新核实的细节和原报道已经刊出的消息。

words.enDefinition: An extension that adds products above the line's existing market tier.

examples.en: The upgraded cover and paper made the premium sketchbook an upward line stretch in the classroom case.
examples.zh: 在课堂案例中，封面和纸张升级后，高端素描本成了一项「产品线向上延伸」。

examples.en: We discussed whether buyers would trust an upward line stretch from the fictional budget stationery brand.
examples.zh: 我们讨论买家是否会信任这个虚构平价文具品牌的「产品线向上延伸」。

collocations: an example of an upward line stretch

words.enDefinition: Research that examines both how consumers use a product category and how they evaluate it or its offerings.

examples.en: The fictional usage and attitude study combines reported use frequency with opinions about a category of containers.
examples.zh: 虚构的「使用与态度调研」将报告的使用频次与对某类容器的看法结合起来。

examples.en: Our worksheet asks which questions in the usage and attitude study describe behaviour and which describe attitudes.
examples.zh: 练习单询问，「使用与态度调研」中哪些问题描述行为，哪些描述态度。

collocations: conduct a usage and attitude study
findings from a usage and attitude study
design of a usage and attitude study

words.enDefinition: A particular event or situation in which a consumer uses a product or service.

examples.en: The fictional diary describes an afternoon studio session as the main usage occasion for the portable folder.
examples.zh: 虚构日记把工作室下午的一次活动描述为便携文件夹的主要「产品使用场合」。

examples.en: Our worksheet distinguishes a usage occasion from when the character originally bought the item in the story.
examples.zh: 练习单区分了「产品使用场合」和故事中角色最初购买这件物品的时点。

words.zhGloss: 按使用频率或用量细分
words.enDefinition: Grouping consumers according to how often or how much they use a category of product.
acceptedZhAnswers: 按使用频率或用量细分

examples.en: The class illustrates usage-rate segmentation by reading a fictional table of rare and frequent categories of use.
examples.zh: 全班阅读一张有关低频和高频使用类别的虚构表格，说明「按使用频率或用量细分」。

examples.en: Our textbook separates usage-rate segmentation from grouping people according to which product features they say they prefer.
examples.zh: 教材把「按使用频率或用量细分」与按消费者所说的产品特征偏好进行分组区分开。

words.enDefinition: Positioning an offering around a particular situation or occasion for its use.

examples.en: The fictional brand tried use-occasion positioning by presenting the small kit as useful during short library visits.
examples.zh: 虚构品牌尝试「基于使用场合的定位」，强调这套小工具适合在图书馆短暂停留时使用。

examples.en: We compared use-occasion positioning for an everyday bag with a plan centered on weekend trips.
examples.zh: 我们把日常用包的「基于使用场合的定位」，与以周末短途出行为重点的方案作比较。

words.enDefinition: Material made and shared by members of the public rather than by the publishing outlet.

examples.en: The newsroom checked the date and creator of user-generated content about the campus book fair before publication.
examples.zh: 刊发前，新闻室核对了有关校园书展的「用户生成内容」的日期和创作者。

examples.en: Our class asked whether the user-generated content should be used after its creator offered permission.
examples.zh: 创作者表示同意后，全班仍讨论这份「用户生成内容」是否适合用于报道。

collocations: request permission to use user-generated content

words.enDefinition: Grouping consumers by whether they are nonusers, first-time users, regular users, or at another stage of use.

examples.en: The fictional dataset uses user status segmentation to distinguish people who have tried a product from nonusers.
examples.zh: 虚构数据集用「按用户使用状态细分」来区分试过产品的人和没有使用的人。

examples.en: Our class compares user status segmentation with a method that only counts frequency among current fictional users.
examples.zh: 全班把「按用户使用状态细分」与仅统计虚构当前用户频次的方法作比较。

words.enDefinition: An incentive to shop or consume to accomplish a practical task or achieve an instrumental benefit.

examples.en: The fictional shopper's main reason for buying a folder is keeping papers organised, which illustrates utilitarian motivation.
examples.zh: 虚构购物者购买文件夹的主要目的是理好纸张，体现了「实用动机」。

examples.en: Our class contrasts utilitarian motivation in the first example with shopping for enjoyment in the second.
examples.zh: 全班把第一个例子的「实用动机」与第二个例子中享受购物乐趣作比较。

words.zhGloss: 寻求多样性的购买行为
words.enDefinition: Switching among offerings for novelty or variety, typically in a relatively low-involvement purchase category.
acceptedZhAnswers: 寻求多样性的购买行为

examples.en: The fictional consumer chooses another biscuit flavour for a change, which illustrates variety-seeking buying behavior in class.
examples.zh: 虚构消费者为了换换口味另选一种饼干，课堂以此说明「寻求多样性的购买行为」。

examples.en: Our reading separates variety-seeking buying behavior from switching products because a previous purchase was disappointing.
examples.zh: 读物把「寻求多样性的购买行为」与因先前购买令人失望而换产品的行为区分开来。

words.enDefinition: Disagreement between businesses at different levels of the same distribution channel

examples.en: The manufacturer and retailer disagree about delivery support, illustrating vertical channel conflict in the case.
examples.zh: 案例中的生产商和零售商就配送支持意见不一，体现了「垂直渠道冲突」。

examples.en: We marked the two levels involved in vertical channel conflict on the class chart.
examples.zh: 我们在课堂图表上标出了涉及「垂直渠道冲突」的两个层级。

words.enDefinition: Distribution arrangement in which firms at successive channel stages operate in coordination

examples.en: The lecture introduces a vertical marketing system through a producer coordinating with its retailers.
examples.zh: 讲座通过生产商与零售商协调运作的情况介绍了「垂直营销渠道系统」。

examples.en: We identified the vertical marketing system in the diagram showing a manufacturer and its retail branches.
examples.zh: 我们在一家生产商及其零售分支的示意图中辨认出了「垂直营销渠道系统」。

collocations: coordination in a vertical marketing system

words.enDefinition: the percentage of measured video views or starts reaching the end under the reporting rule

examples.en: Video completion rate was higher for the shorter advertisement in the class's sample figures.
examples.zh: 课堂示例数据中，较短广告的「视频完播率」更高。

examples.en: The analyst checked whether both reports used video starts as the denominator for video completion rate.
examples.zh: 分析人员核对两份报告是否都用视频开始播放次数作「视频完播率」的分母。

words.enDefinition: assigning credit for a later action to a prior advertising exposure that did not receive a click

examples.en: The exercise used view-through attribution when a ticket buyer received an ad impression without clicking the ad.
examples.zh: 购票者先前有一次广告展示记录，但未点击广告，练习将这种情况归为「曝光后归因」。

examples.en: The media report presented view-through attribution separately from actions credited to people clicking the banner.
examples.zh: 广告报告分别列出「曝光后归因」与归因于点击横幅的行为。

words.enDefinition: the extent to which an online advertisement meets criteria for being visible on the screen

examples.en: The publisher measured viewability to see how often the advertisement appeared within the visible portion of the page.
examples.zh: 出版方测量「广告可见性」，了解广告有多经常出现在页面可见区域内。

examples.en: The media report discussed viewability separately from the number of advertisements the system delivered.
examples.zh: 投放报告分别讨论「广告可见性」和系统交付的广告次数。

words.enDefinition: advertising cost per one thousand impressions that meet the applicable viewability criteria

examples.en: The buyer compared viewable CPM across two publications using the same minimum visibility requirements.
examples.zh: 采购人员用同样的最低可见性要求，比较了两家出版方的「千次可见展示成本」。

examples.en: Our worksheet lists regular CPM and viewable CPM in separate columns for each placement.
examples.zh: 练习表为每个投放位置分两栏记录普通千次展示成本和「千次可见展示成本」。

words.enDefinition: an ad impression meeting the applicable minimum criteria for on-screen area and display time

examples.en: The report counted a viewable impression only when the ad met both area and time requirements.
examples.zh: 只有广告同时达到可见面积和持续时间要求时，报告才计为一次「可见展示」。

examples.en: The tutor asked why a served advertisement might fail to count as a viewable impression.
examples.zh: 导师问，为什么一个送达的广告可能无法计为「可见展示」。

words.enDefinition: Extent to which viewers continue watching through points in a programme

examples.en: The sample graph shows viewer retention falling shortly before the credits begin.
examples.zh: 样本图表显示，「观众留存」在片尾字幕出现前不久开始下降。

examples.en: We used the viewer retention curve to identify where viewers stopped watching.
examples.zh: 我们用「观众留存」曲线辨认观众在哪个位置停止观看。

words.enDefinition: Amount of viewing expressed in minutes under a stated counting rule

examples.en: The dashboard uses viewing minutes to describe how long the group watched each series.
examples.zh: 仪表板用「观看分钟数」描述该组观看每部剧的时长。

examples.en: We compared viewing minutes without assuming both episodes had the same duration.
examples.zh: 我们比较了「观看分钟数」，没有假定两集的节目时长相同。

words.enDefinition: Selected group whose viewing is measured to estimate a broader audience

examples.en: The methodology section explains how the viewing panel represents a broader television audience.
examples.zh: 方法章节解释了「收视调查样本组」如何代表更广泛的电视受众。

examples.en: We distinguished the viewing panel from the full population in the classroom diagram.
examples.zh: 我们在课堂图示中将「收视调查样本组」与总体区分开来。

words.enDefinition: Proportion of all viewing in a defined period attributable to particular content

examples.en: The chart shows viewing share for two channels during the same evening period.
examples.zh: 图表显示两个频道在同一晚间时段的「收视份额」。

examples.en: We checked which viewing was included in the denominator for viewing share.
examples.zh: 我们检查了「收视份额」的分母中包括哪些观看行为。

words.enDefinition: An organized set of visual elements used consistently to identify a brand.

examples.en: The fictional campus store used one visual identity system across labels, shelf signs, and its online catalogue.
examples.zh: 虚构校园商店在标签、货架标牌和在线目录上使用统一的「视觉识别系统」。

examples.en: The project team assembled a visual identity system using a shared typeface, palette, and set of shapes.
examples.zh: 项目小组用统一的字体、色板和一组图形组成「视觉识别系统」。

words.enDefinition: Presentation of retail merchandise through displays and other visual elements

examples.en: The tutorial uses visual merchandising to explain how the display groups related goods.
examples.zh: 辅导课用「视觉陈列」解释展台如何将相关商品放在一起。

examples.en: The student team compared visual merchandising in two layouts for the same shop.
examples.zh: 学生团队对比了同一家商店两种布局的「视觉陈列」。

words.enDefinition: Checking whether a picture or video accurately represents what it is claimed to show.

examples.en: The student newsroom used visual verification to check whether the supplied picture showed this year's public fair.
examples.zh: 校园新闻室通过「视觉资料核验」检查所提供的图片是否拍摄自今年的公开集市。

examples.en: Our visual verification compared the mock photograph with a publicly available image of the same building.
examples.zh: 我们进行「视觉资料核验」时，把模拟照片与同一座建筑的公开图片作了比较。

words.enDefinition: A retailer offering members a wide range of goods, often in bulk, in a low-service warehouse setting.

examples.en: The lecture describes a warehouse club that sells larger packages to members.
examples.zh: 讲座描述了一家向会员出售大包装商品的「仓储会员店」。

examples.en: We compared the warehouse club with a supermarket offering smaller package sizes.
examples.zh: 我们将「仓储会员店」与提供较小规格包装的超市作了比较。

words.enDefinition: Researching a product online before buying it in a physical store

examples.en: The worksheet illustrates webrooming when a shopper researches models online and buys in store.
examples.zh: 习题用购物者先在线上查看型号、再到门店购买的情形说明「先网查后到店购」。

examples.en: We mapped webrooming separately from the path that ended with online checkout.
examples.zh: 我们将「先网查后到店购」和最后在线上结账的路径分开绘制。

words.enDefinition: Sound recorded separately from synchronized picture for later use in editing

examples.en: The crew records a wild track of footsteps after the camera stops rolling.
examples.zh: 摄像机停止拍摄后，摄制组另录了一条脚步声「非同步现场音轨」。

examples.en: We checked whether the wild track matched the atmosphere of the finished scene.
examples.zh: 我们检查了「非同步现场音轨」是否贴合成片场景的氛围。

collocations: sound captured as a wild track

words.enDefinition: Arrangement of merchandise or imagery in a shop's outward-facing window

examples.en: The student project uses a window display to introduce the store's new assortment.
examples.zh: 学生项目通过「橱窗陈列」介绍商店的新商品组合。

examples.en: We sketched a window display that grouped notebooks by cover design.
examples.zh: 我们画了一张按封面设计摆放笔记本的「橱窗陈列」草图。

words.enDefinition: Written news material distributed by a wire service for publication use.

examples.en: The student editor compared the wire copy with the local reporter's notes before writing a short update.
examples.zh: 学生编辑写简短更新前，把「通讯社供稿」与当地记者的笔记作了比较。

examples.en: The regional paper used wire copy for the opening summary and added its own campus interviews.
examples.zh: 地区报纸用「通讯社供稿」写开头摘要，同时加入了自己做的校园采访。

words.enDefinition: An outlet's use or publication of material supplied by a wire service.

examples.en: The instructor used wire pickup to explain why identical regional reports appeared in several fictional newspapers.
examples.zh: 老师用「转载通讯社稿件」解释了为什么几家虚构报纸会刊登内容相同的地区报道。

examples.en: We noted the wire pickup after finding the wire service credit on the regional news website.
examples.zh: 看到地区新闻网站注明稿件来自通讯社之后，我们记录了这次「转载通讯社稿件」的情况。

collocations: a wire pickup by a local newspaper

words.enDefinition: A service distributing news reports or other material to subscriber outlets.

examples.en: The student editor checked the wire service for updates before revising the regional news roundup.
examples.zh: 学生编辑在修改地区新闻综述之前，先查了「通讯社供稿服务」里的最新报道。

examples.en: Our exercise used a fictional wire service to show how several newspapers could receive the same report.
examples.zh: 练习用虚构的「通讯社供稿服务」展示多家报纸如何收到同一篇稿件。

collocations: a report from a wire service

words.zhGloss: 细分群体内部的相似性
words.enDefinition: The degree to which members of the same market segment share characteristics relevant to the segmentation.
acceptedZhAnswers: 细分群体内部的相似性

examples.en: The fictional results illustrate within-segment similarity when most members of one group report the same practical need.
examples.zh: 虚构结果中，同一组的大多数成员报告相同实际需求，用以说明「细分群体内部的相似性」。

examples.en: Our class compares within-segment similarity across two alternative ways of grouping the fictional survey responses in the worksheet.
examples.zh: 全班比较练习单中用两种不同方式对虚构问卷回答分组所表现出的「细分群体内部的相似性」。

words.enDefinition: A logo formed primarily from the stylized written name of a brand.

examples.en: The new wordmark used only the fictional brand's name in a distinctive style of lettering.
examples.zh: 新的「品牌文字标识」只用虚构品牌的名字，通过独特字形表现出来。

examples.en: We compared the wordmark with the icon that could appear on its own in smaller spaces.
examples.zh: 我们把「品牌文字标识」与可在狭小位置独立使用的图标作比较。

words.enDefinition: Team or working setting where writers develop a television series collaboratively

examples.en: A mock writers' room outlined three episode ideas during the afternoon workshop.
examples.zh: 模拟「编剧室」在下午的工作坊中拟出了三集剧情构思。

examples.en: We divided tasks within the writers' room after agreeing on the season arc.
examples.zh: 我们就全季的故事走向达成一致后，在「编剧室」里分了工。

words.enDefinition: Setting a common delivered price within each designated geographical zone

examples.en: The case uses zone pricing so delivery-inclusive prices differ between the two regions.
examples.zh: 案例采用「分区定价」，使两个地区的含运费价格有所不同。

examples.en: We mapped the zones before comparing the prices set under zone pricing.
examples.zh: 我们先画出各个区域，再比较「分区定价」下设定的价格。
